With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

UNILEVER INDONESIA has been serving Indonesian consumers for more than 90 years with at least two Unilever brands in every Indonesian household.  Unilever Indonesia (ULI) has a leadership position with a corporate market share currently of 35.4%, operates in 15 FMCG categories with 43 well-known brands and holds market leadership position in 13 categories. Top 15 brands contributed to 80% of ULI Turnover. Unilever Indonesia is one of Business Group Led Country, in which split into 4 different Business Units: Personal Care, Foods, Home Care and Beauty & Wellbeing.

FOODS is the second largest Business Group (BG) in Unilever with global multibillion-dollar brands such as Knorr and Hellmann’s and many regional and local brands. Foods BG’s vision is to be a World-Class Force for Good in Food, which means doing well by doing good. It is about being boldly healthier all the way from farm to fork. Its Boldly Healthier strategy strives for a future where good food can reach 10 billion plates to feed the world while caring for the planet. It’s that goal that underpins Unilever Foods’s purpose. Through programs of regenerative agriculture, highlighting nutrient-focused foods, increasing its plant-based portfolio, combating food waste, and design for net zero, we want to take care of the planet and the people that belong to it.

FOODS INDONESIA is a sizeable business for Foods BG, accounting for more than 500 mEUR TurnOver. Royco and Bango make 80% of the turnover and are about 200m Euro each, making them Olympic most loved brands in the country. With market leadership across the entire portfolio, Foods Indonesia prerogative to is to continue the growth momentum. The establishment the reset fundamentals is ongoing, ensuring the right governance end to end to sustain a long-term healthy growth for the business is imperative.

Our business will build desire at scale & bring unmissable taste to every dish our consumers make.   • Translate the Business Unit's strategic vision into comprehensive Brand Marketing Plans specifically tailored for the market, acting as the guardian of these plans and ensuring their effective implementation.
  • Drive all marketing activities focused on Consumer Demand Creation and Value Creation, including brand activation, consumer insights generation, data analytics, digital marketing, content development, strategic partnerships, and the planning and execution of in-market experiential events across all brands in the market, covering global brands and local jewels of Foods Indonesia, ensuring the "social first" agenda is properly embedded in the country plans specific for Condiments, Bango and Beverages with the business size around 300mEUR.
  • Drive penetration growth, owning seasons / occasions / locations as well as driving the "many Indonesia" agenda with the right portfolio 
  • Head portfolio transformation and translating insights into winning marketing proposition
  • Oversee consumer trends in Foods markets and takes a strategic lead to ensure that Unilever can outperform competitors. 
  • Accountable for the development and delivery of the annual category plans, working closely with the global team. 
  • Own the Demand Creation and Content Supply Chain processes and governance for the market; representing the country in Business Group discussions and decisions.

Skill & Experience

  • Demand Creation Leadership: 15+ years of proven experience in marketing, with a strong emphasis on demand generation, brand building, and digital marketing within the consumer goods industry. Experience in the foods industry is highly desirable.

Unilever is currently hiring for SHE Capabilities manager - Construction & Contractor Safety SHE Capabilities manager - Construction & Contractor Safety Based in Grha Unilever

Job Description: 

Unilever has robust external and internal commitments for protecting people, partners, community and planet. The Safety, Health and Environmental (SHE) community facilitates progress against those targets.  Strong, solid and effective Capability in SHE throughout the organization is vital to effectively ensure SHE compliance across the organization and those it touches. This is ensured through global SHE Standards, Systems, Programs and Solutions.

We are seeking a Global SHE Capability manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will be a member of the SHE capability expertise team Zero Harm to People, focusing on Construction Safety owning standards, systems, programs and solutions in scope, enhancing capability and fostering a strong SHE culture on sites and within and beyond the Unilever organization.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership and Ownership: 

  • Responsible for select global Standards, Systems, Programs and Solutions of the Expertise Platform and the in year and longer term deliverables.
  • Leads, and mentors users across the globe; sets and agrees deliverables, provides guidance and support to ensure effective implementation of the expertise platform deliverables of area of responsiblity.
  • Is the overall subject matter expert of the selected scope and leads by example; speaks up, encourages safe behaviors and practices, fosters a learning environment
  • Stays abreast of industry advancements and regulations as it relates to the selected scope and builds best available technology into Unilever.

Global Standards: 

  • Develops, reviews, and updates selected SHE scope within the expertise platform in line with international regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  • Responsible for enabling all sites to comply by ensuring design and timely implementation is done of the needed updates, tools, training, certification & support
  • Develops and delivers SHE training programs to employees globally, ensuring awareness and compliance with these SHE standards.

Global Systems, Programs And Solutions

  • Is responsible for systems and programs within selected scope in the platform, improvements and implementation as agreed in year
  • Is responsible for delivering the Global (digital) project and/or Global (digital) tools at agreed priority sites in year and/or the improvements of the project within the Expertise platform
  • Works with engineering to control risks and hazards within the expertise platform scope to proactively reduce risk to people, community and planet effectively

Continuous Improvement

  • Reviews investigations of SHE incidents, analyzes root causes, and implement preventive measures across all regions.
  • Identifies structural issues and initiates improvement initiatives to enhance SHE performance and reduce risks globally.
  • Ensures horizontal expansion of best practices and lessons learned to avoid reoccurrence of incidents
  • Leads investigations of highly impactful events when called upon.

Stakeholder Engagement: 

  • Collaborates with internal and external stakeholders globally to promote SHE initiatives and foster a culture of Zero Harm.
  • Fosters the relationships within SHE and with other functions to deliver with impact
  • Comfortable with and able to influence senior leaders in SHE and across the business to deliver with impact

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in, (civil) Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in (civil) engineering incl training and/or safety management in construction projects, preferably in a local, regional and global role at a multinational. Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven ability to deliver on time in full through others
  • Experience working in a multicultural environment.
  • Strong knowledge of safety regulations and compliance standards.
  • Proficiency in SHE management systems and tools
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and site personnel.
  • Certification in safety training (e.g., OSHA, NEBOSH) is a plus.

Leadership

  • You are responsible for your own results and as a manager, you also need to motivate others to deliver with passion, creating an inclusive and engaging climate around you. You can balance challenge with support and coaching. You understand the wider business context and use your emotional intelligence to motivate people to deliver what is needed.

Critical SOL (Standards of Leadership) Behaviors

  • PERSONAL MASTERY: Sets high standards for themselves. Has emotional intelligence to take feedback, manage mood and motivations, and build empathy for others.
  • PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE: Generates intensity and focus to motivate people to deliver results at speed. Takes personal responsibility and accountability for execution and results.
  • TALENT CATALYST: Invests in people – coaches individuals and teams to realize their full potential. Creates an inclusive climate, empowering everyone to be at their best.
  • PURPOSE & SERVICE: Has humility, understanding that leadership is service to others, inside and outside Unilever.
  • CONSUMER LOVE: Invests time inside and outside to understand the needs of consumers.

Critical Unilever Behaviors

  • 3 STEPS AHEAD: leads with curiosity and confidence and builds for the future
  • CARE DEEPLY: cares deeply for performance, own growth and development
  • FOCUS ON WHAT COUNTS: delivers against clear and stretching goals to realize maximum performance impact
  • DELIVER WITH EXCELLENCE: takes personal ownership and holds self and others to account

Looking for Your Dream Job? Join The Magnum Ice Cream Company!

IC GTM SC Lead - Unica & TR On Premise

Function: GTM Supply Chain / Integrated Planning

Scope: Local / Regional

Reports to: Emre Engin

Location: Istanbul Head Office

Terms & Conditions: Full Time

The Ice Cream division at Unilever is preparing to stand on its own, aiming to become an independent, EUR 8.3 billion publicly listed company by the end of 2025. We’re on a mission to create the ultimate snacking company. A place where growth, innovation, founder and ownership mentality, and performance are cultivated and rewarded. And where we craft extraordinary ice cream experiences - transforming ordinary moments into lasting memories. Because we know, life tastes better with ice cream.

About The Magnum Ice Cream Company

The Magnum Ice Cream Company is all about growth. Growing our business. Growing our customers’ businesses. Growing our people’s careers. Growth begins with empowerment. So we free our people to be innovative, responsible entrepreneurs, driven and equipped to give our consumers more amazing products and unforgettable moments – and having fun doing it.

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry. We have been taking pleasure seriously for more than 100 years, serving happiness with every lick or scoop of ice cream for generations.

We are investing to unlock the full growth potential of The Magnum Ice Cream Company as a standalone entity, once we separate from Unilever, which is planned to happen before the end of 2025.

We dream big but keep things simple to act fast.

If you want to grow with us, make an impact, and shape the future of Ice Cream, this is the place for you!

Job Purpose

Find your purpose at TMICC. You’ll be responsible of managing E2E SC operations for Unica region (Central Asia) and demand planning operation of Türkiye On Premise business. You will sit in the middle of S&OP Process, where you will work closely with our customer development, marketing, and sourcing unit teams to build an integrated volume and sales plan, you will coordinate the delivery of the results and make shifts on the forecast based on consumption or business need changes, and hence will manage all downstream supply chain operations. If you are an expert in communication, willing to guide related stakeholders to grow our business together and ready to be owner of short/mid/long-term forecasting by your analytical thinking aspects, then this role is just for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generation of volume and value forecasting through executing the demand planning components of the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process.
  • To understand past and future assumptions, risks, and opportunities, and clean the sales data and build base forecast while keeping track of sales and marketing activity logs
  • To lead the development and facilitate the deployment of new capabilities in Demand Planning such as improvements on S&OP processes and digitalization of the forecasting and E2E S&OP
  • To manage inventory while ensuring maximum service level & availability. Minimizing business waste risk by actively managing over and residual inventory. Ensure guardrail processes and governance to manage inventory and business waste
  • To support and work with the category leadership team, providing E2E supply chain business partnership
  • To build long term customer experience strategy supported by short-mid term agenda to improve customer relations
  • To work in close communication with internal and external stakeholders to highlight risks and opportunities and trigger decision making, integrating CS perspective to E2E processes
  • To balance SC priorities with customer expectations and needs, enhancing SC responsiveness
  • To manage Sourcing and Logistics operations
  • To track R&D, Regulatory and Quality operations

What You Need To Succeed

Experiences & Qualifications

  • BSc. in Engineering
  • 5+ Years of operational experience, planning experience is must.
  • Excellence in English and Turkish communication, Russian is plus.
  • Strong stakeholder management experience is preferred.
  • Challenging the status quo and pushing the limits within SC and business operations
  • Expertise in communication skills as well as influencing & persuading
  • Analytical thinking and data analysis competencies

Skills

  • Problem solving
  • Effective Communication
  • Digital Awareness
  • Change Management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Collaboration
  • Data Analytic
  • Risk Management

LEADERSHIP: The Ice Cream Way

We Are Looking For Bold, Driven Individuals Who Thrive In a Fast-paced, Dynamic Environment And Share Our Approach To Growth, Collaboration, And Innovation. Here’s What Defines Success In Our Organization

Focus on Growth – Embracing new challenges, seeking opportunities to innovate, and continuously looking for ways to expand and improve. Whether it’s scaling markets, evolving roles, or leading teams, we value those who see possibilities and take initiative.

Speed & Simplicity – Working efficiently, adapting quickly, and simplifying processes by leveraging technology to drive better outcomes. With ethical decision-making as the backbone to this, we drive agility and stay focused.

Winning with Fun – Collaborating, integrating seamlessly with a founder/owner mindset, keeping what’s best for the company at the heart of all that is done. We build diverse, inclusive, and winning teams that drive our business.

Bold Innovations – Experimenting with fresh ideas and innovative thinking that shape our industry, through product development, process improvements, and customer experiences. Being obsessed with the consumer, we embrace change to drive growth.

Care & Challenge – Fostering an open, transparent environment where team members can grow, share feedback openly, holding themselves and each other to high standards while maintaining a strong sense of support and camaraderie.

Expertise in our category – A deep understanding of our industry, customers, and market trends enabling us to stay ahead and turn challenges into opportunities. Curiosity, insight, and a willingness to learn and lead enables us to remain market makers.

If these qualities resonate with you, we’d love to connect and explore how you can be part of our team.

#TMICC

Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! Thus if you require any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of your application so that we can support you through your recruitment journey.

job_summary: Background & Purpose of the Job As a Logistics Process Specialist, you will be responsible for executing current logistics workflows while collaborating with the broader Logistics team to drive automation and improve the freight payment process. The initial focus will be on learning and managing the North America invoice processing for CASS shipments, as well as any other freight audit and payment technologies currently in use. You will oversee carrier billing portfolios, identify system inefficiencies, and support process optimization. Over time, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives, eliminate manual touchpoints, and become the subject matter expert for the entire freight payment ecosystem. This role requires close coordination with multiple internal departments and external partners to ensure efficient and seamless operations. Key Responsibilities Process invoices for a designated carrier portfolio within the CASS system and other freight audit and payment (FAP) technologies. Manage carrier billing relationships to ensure accuracy, timely resolution of issues, and strong communication. Support exception handling and correction for all carrier invoices received. Identify and recommend process and system efficiencies and best practices—both in external workflows and in the use of Unilever’s FAP systems. Develop strategies to eliminate manual processing within FAP and drive automation. Serve as a Subject Matter Expert for our FAP processes and systems, including reporting, system utilization, and continuous improvement. Collaborate cross-functionally to optimize freight payment processes and support broader logistics initiatives. Who You Are & What You’ll Do You’re a natural leader – You inspire collaboration and accountability across teams, even when they don’t report directly to you. You’re confident in having tough conversations when needed and equally committed to celebrating wins and supporting the growth of colleagues and business partners. You’re a connector of dots – You thrive in complexity, identifying patterns and building clear, repeatable processes. You translate ambiguity into actionable workflows and communicate them effectively across diverse stakeholder groups. You’re driven to win—and enjoy the journey – You bring creativity, resilience, and a positive attitude to every challenge. Your ability to stay composed and solution-focused makes you someone others want to work with and learn from. You’re a changemaker – You embrace innovation and continuously seek better ways to work. You champion new technologies and process improvements, influencing others to adopt change while empowering them to make it their own. Desired Qualifications Strong leadership, communication, and collaboration skills. Ability to identify patterns and use insights to drive process improvements. Quick learner with the ability to grasp complex concepts and apply knowledge effectively. Experience with SAP, OTM, CASS, and other freight audit and payment (FAP) systems and processes is a plus. Requirements Minimum of 2 years of experience in freight audit, logistics bill payment, transportation operations, or related logistics functions. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis. A bachelor's degree in business, supply chain management, logistics, or another relevant discipline. Pay: The pay range for this position is $69,360 to $104,040. Unilever takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are utilized in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs. Bonus: This position is bonus eligible. Long-Term Incentive (LTI): This position is LTI eligible. Benefits: Unilever employees are eligible to participate in our benefits plan. Should the employee choose to participate, they can choose from a range of benefits to include, but is not limited to, health insurance (including prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage), retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, sick leave, paid vacation and holidays, as well as access to numerous voluntary benefits. Any coverages for health insurance and retirement benefits will be in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and associated governing plan documents. Background & Purpose of the Job

As a Logistics Process Specialist, you will be responsible for executing current logistics workflows while collaborating with the broader Logistics team to drive automation and improve the freight payment process. The initial focus will be on learning and managing the North America invoice processing for CASS shipments, as well as any other freight audit and payment technologies currently in use.

You will oversee carrier billing portfolios, identify system inefficiencies, and support process optimization. Over time, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives, eliminate manual touchpoints, and become the subject matter expert for the entire freight payment ecosystem. This role requires close coordination with multiple internal departments and external partners to ensure efficient and seamless operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Process invoices for a designated carrier portfolio within the CASS system and other freight audit and payment (FAP) technologies.
  • Manage carrier billing relationships to ensure accuracy, timely resolution of issues, and strong communication.
  • Support exception handling and correction for all carrier invoices received.
  • Identify and recommend process and system efficiencies and best practices—both in external workflows and in the use of Unilever’s FAP systems.
  • Develop strategies to eliminate manual processing within FAP and drive automation.
  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert for our FAP processes and systems, including reporting, system utilization, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to optimize freight payment processes and support broader logistics initiatives.

Who You Are & What You’ll Do

  • You’re a natural leader – You inspire collaboration and accountability across teams, even when they don’t report directly to you. You’re confident in having tough conversations when needed and equally committed to celebrating wins and supporting the growth of colleagues and business partners.
  • You’re a connector of dots – You thrive in complexity, identifying patterns and building clear, repeatable processes. You translate ambiguity into actionable workflows and communicate them effectively across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • You’re driven to win—and enjoy the journey – You bring creativity, resilience, and a positive attitude to every challenge. Your ability to stay composed and solution-focused makes you someone others want to work with and learn from.
  • You’re a changemaker – You embrace innovation and continuously seek better ways to work. You champion new technologies and process improvements, influencing others to adopt change while empowering them to make it their own.

Desired Qualifications

  • Strong leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to identify patterns and use insights to drive process improvements.
  • Quick learner with the ability to grasp complex concepts and apply knowledge effectively.
  • Experience with SAP, OTM, CASS, and other freight audit and payment (FAP) systems and processes is a plus.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in freight audit, logistics bill payment, transportation operations, or related logistics functions.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis.
  • A bachelor's degree in business, supply chain management, logistics, or another relevant discipline.

Pay: The pay range for this position is $69,360 to $104,040. Unilever takes into consideration a wide range of factors that are utilized in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs. 

Bonus: This position is bonus eligible. 

Long-Term Incentive (LTI): This position is LTI eligible. 

Benefits: Unilever employees are eligible to participate in our benefits plan. Should the employee choose to participate, they can choose from a range of benefits to include, but is not limited to, health insurance (including prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage), retirement savings benefits, life insurance and disability benefits, parental leave, sick leave, paid vacation and holidays, as well as access to numerous voluntary benefits. Any coverages for health insurance and retirement benefits will be in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and associated governing plan documents. 

At Unilever, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We welcome applicants from all walks of life and are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive/succeed. All applicants will receive fair and respectful consideration, and we actively support the growth and development of every employee.

Unilever Is An Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Persons With Disabilities.

For more information on your federal rights, please see Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal

Employment is subject to verification of pre-screening tests, which may include drug screening, background check, credit check and DMV check.

If you are an individual with a disability in need of assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please contact us at NA.Accommodations@unilever.com. Please note: This email is reserved for individuals with disabilities in need of assistance and is not a means of inquiry about positions or application statuses. The Protected Veterans or Individuals with Disabilities AAP narratives are available for inspection by any employee or applicant for employment Monday through Friday during normal business hours at establishment.

  • Identyfikacja problemów jakościowych oraz wdrażanie rozwiązań mających na celu usprawnienie procesów oraz poprawę jakości wyrobów w tym eliminację defektów jakościowych
  • Wspieranie pracy interdyscyplinarnych zespołów w tematach związanych z zarządzaniem jakością i bezpieczeństwem konsumenta
  • Inicjonowanie usprawnień jakościowych i procesowych, zmian na maszynach
  • Zarządzanie incydentem jakościowym, określanie przyczyn źródłowych, nadzorowanie działań korygujących
  • Monitorowanie wskaźników jakościowych, przygotowywanie raportów i niezbędnej dokumentacji w zakresie zarządzania incydentami jakościowymi

Nasze Wymagania

  • Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne
  • Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia na podobnym stanowisku w firmie produkcyjnej
  • Znajomość technik i narzędzi używanych w zapewnianiu jakości produkcji
  • Podstawową znajomość z zakresu budowy maszyn
  • Znasz systemy optymalizacji procesów produkcyjnych
  • Umiejętność tworzenia dokumentacji technicznej
  • Znajomość języka angielskiego w stopniu komunikatywnym
  • Zdolności analityczne oraz doskonale umiejętności komunikacyjne

Mile Widziane

  • doświadczenie w branży spożywczej

To Oferujemy

  • zatrudnienia w oparciu o umowę o pracę w międzynarodowej firmie
  • system pracy PN-PT oraz elastyczny godziny pracy
  • dedykowany rozwój i dostęp do szkoleń i warsztatów
  • najwyższe standardy bezpieczeństwa i jakości
  • bezpośredni udział w międzynarodowych projektach

PAKIET Benefitów, z których skorzystasz Ty i Twoi bliscy, m.in.:

  • darmową, prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover
  • dostęp do kafeterii My Benefit z możliwością wyboru benefitów, z których chcesz skorzystać (np. karta Multisport, bilety do kina, bony do sklepów i wiele więcej)
  • świadczenia urlopowe i świąteczne z ZFŚS
  • pracowniczy Program Emerytalny
  • możliwość zakupu produktów Unilever w atrakcyjnych cenach
  • dofinansowanie do wypoczynku dla pracowników i dzieci
  • dodatkowy płatny urlop wypoczynkowy

Unilever is currently hiring for Territory Manager!

Function: Customer Development

Work Level: WL1

Reports to: Geography Sales Manager

Scope: Local

Location: Gujranwala

Terms & Conditions: Full-time

About Unilever

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

Job Purpose

Our Territory Manager is our front-line leader who manages the distributors and trade for the designated territory to ensure effective and efficient distribution operations and deliver sales, Key Performance Indicators / targets. If you want to develop an in-depth understanding of the world of sales and help drive meaningful change through Unilever’s purposeful growth and digital transformation agenda, then this role would interest you.

What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be

  • Drive the business to the desired ambition Underlying Volume / Sales Growth.
  • Uplift the Competitive visibility in Store.
  • Coordinate with Distributor/Customer Operational plans / Executions.
  • Negotiate with Customer for Joint Business planning.
  • Efficiently plan and manage eRTM, build optimized routes for DSRs.
  • Support digital transformation strategy for your territory.
  • Have the acumen for Financial Matrix – Business Profitability / Gross Margin.
  • Lead and drive an extended team – Build team & develop talent.
  • Be accountable to uphold the business Key Performance Indicators.
  • Redefine the process post execution analysis with strong analytical skills.

What You Need To Succeed

Experiences & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 1-4 years of relevant sales experience in FMCG industry is preferred.

Skills

  • Have strong business and financial acumen.
  • Strong Communication and Negotiation Skills.
  • Command over Microsoft Office and Power BI
  • Active feet on street and market time
  • Capability to Strategize and possess strong execution skills.
  • Updated with competition insights.
  • This is an empowered role hence the resource should display accountability, responsibility and have strong bias for action.

Leadership

  • You are an inclusive motivator of people. Your team deliver with real passion, growing and learning from each other whilst delivering quick wins.
  • You are still responsible for your own results and as a manager, you also need to motivate others to deliver with passion, creating an inclusive and engaging climate around you. You can balance challenge with support and coaching. You understand the wider business context and you are emotionally intelligent enough to motivate people to deliver what is needed.

Critical SOL (Standards of Leadership) Behaviors

  • PERSONAL MASTERY: Sets high standards for themselves. Has emotional intelligence to take feedback, manage mood and motivations, and build empathy for others.
  • PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE: Generates intensity and focus to motivate people to deliver results at speed. Takes personal responsibility and accountability for execution and results.
  • TALENT CATALYST: Invests in people – coaches individuals and teams to realize their full potential. Creates an inclusive climate, empowering everyone to be at their best.
  • PURPOSE & SERVICE: Has humility, understanding that leadership is service to others, inside and outside Unilever.
  • CONSUMER LOVE: Invests time inside and outside to understand the needs of consumers.
  • BUSINESS ACUMEN: Creates sustainable growth with purpose, engaging different partners across the system for change.

Unilever is currently hiring for PROCUREMENT OPERATIONS ASSISTANT MANAGER SEA & Indonesia

Scope: SEA & Indonesia

Location: Thailand, Philippines, Indonesia

Job Purpose

Unilever is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. If you are excited by daily challenges and love to work with internal and external partners to find creative solutions then this role is just for you!

You will be part of the Procurement Operations Team, taking responsibility for South East Asia and Indonesia (SEAI) operational activities to ensure a smooth supply of materials for our production – in-house or at our external Collaborative Manufacturers. In the current challenging times, the Procurement Operations team in SEAI is playing a crucial role securing undisrupted continuation of our production operations.

The majority of your time you will spend on troubleshooting in all different aspects of our SEAI Operations. You will support our internal sourcing units and/or Collaborative Manufacturers (CMs) in case of material supply issues and any other material related issues that might appear. You collaborate with all relevant internal and external stakeholders and coordinate the communication and issue resolution.

Together with our colleagues from R&D and Supply Chain, you work on projects to proactively prevent service disruption by driving service- and quality improvement as well as resilience for the raw and packaging material portfolio.

What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be

  • Driving service for raw and packaging material supply, mitigating upcoming supply/service risks through innovative and creative solutions (short and long-term) in collaboration with internal and external partners
  • Able to quickly build knowledge on various buying portfolios to take decisions on how to solve problems. Take that extra step to safeguard Unilever’s production.
  • Build a solid network within the company and with the main material suppliers and CMs.
  • Monitor capacity and capability at suppliers including mould utilisation in line with the Business Plan to assure continuity of supply, liaise with portfolio teams for contract coverage on key materials
  • Manage mould health and refurbishment projects including capex management for the respective portfolio, implement Mould management best practice
  • Collaborate with procurement manager on troubleshooting in all different aspects of our European Operations.
  • Identify and drive contingency and resilience activities; identify and follow up on opportunities to add flexibility to the supply chain.
  • Contribute to short and long term service and quality improvement projects together with suppliers.
  • Coordinating quality loss claims caused by material non-compliances
  • To ensure the satisfaction of Unilever's internal customers with the services provided by the procurement organization

What You Need To Succeed

Experiences & Qualifications

  • 3-5 years in FMCG Supply Chain (planning) or Procurement related roles
  • English language skills
  • Managing stakeholders
  • Effective trouble shooter – able to remain calm in times of crisis and creative mindset to identify solutions
  • Self-starter with strong accountability & responsibility standards

Skills

  • Business partnering
  • Risk management
  • Stakeholder management
  • Supplier Relationship management
  • Strategic influencing
  • Financial Acumen
  • Fully operational in Excel - being able to extract, analyse and present data in a clear and understandable format
  • Project management skills

Leadership

  • You are energized by delivering fantastic results. You are an example to others – both your results and your resilience. You are constantly on the lookout for better ways to do things, engaging and collaborating with others along the way.

About Procurement

Part of the Supply Chain family, Procurement is responsible for over 30B Euro of material and services spend globally with more than 60,000 suppliers, over half of them in MBS. Getting the right services and materials, sustainably sourced and ensuring responsible procurement is critical to ensuring our brands with purpose grow. Our teams work closely with the business to understand stakeholders needs, bring innovation to meet changing consumer, employees’, and customers’ needs, and drive financial value for Unilever through competitive buying. We’re at the forefront of digital procurement, bringing new tools and analytics to drive data-based decisions.

Our strategy is ‘Procurement with Purpose’ and focuses on buying responsibly, buying better, and growing together with partners around the world. Our ambition is based on three key drivers: being Purpose-Led, Value-Driven, and Future-Fit.

Within Capex and Utilities, the Assistant Procurement Manager Utilities & Decarbonization is responsible for the sourcing strategy development, implementation, and procurement in the Utilities procurement category for their geography. This role will be responsible to achieve our decarbonization strategy to Scope 1, 2 and 3 (Green House Gas (GHG) emissions that the company makes directly and indirectly in all value chain) from a Procurement standpoint in support of our business strategy covering European region. This role forms a key business partner with Supply chain, Sustainability team and Engineering at supply chain sites.

The Assistant Procurement Manager will increase efficiency of our Utiliites and Decarbonisation procurement by driving scale where it makes sense, decreasing fragmentation, pooling expertise across European region, prioritizing higher impact spend areas, leveraging technology and data, and delivering on best practices.

Job Purpose

Unilever is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. If you are willing to join a strong passionate multicultural team and contribute directly to the Unilever Decarbonization commitments then this role is just for you!

What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be

  • Specialist for Thermal Procurement, including Natural Gas, Biomethane, Biomass, Biofuels, GPPA’s (Gas Power Purchase agreements)
  • Be accountable for the implementation of the Utilities and Decarbonization Procurement strategies and best practices across EU
  • Support and guide the procurement organization across EU’s Factories to meet goals and objectives in support of the overall Unilever Strategy
  • Pro-actively engage with the utility & decarbonization procurement leads and peers to understand the strategic plan in their region and drive best practices
  • To build and maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders and user communities across Unilever business by being the critical point of contact for Europe
  • Engage with key suppliers (Utilities, Decarbonization) and develop understanding of their capabilities and solutions. Be aware of industry key drivers, new technologies and new sustainability capabilities.
  • Help develop and execute ongoing communications with the business for the selected sourcing strategies and progress
  • Support identifying opportunities across Supply Chain and their connections with Utilities, Decarbonization, Renewable Sources
  • To take ownership on and lead projects in procurement across the key areas of Partnership with Purpose (PWP), Responsible Partner Policy (RPP), Sustainability, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), Savings, Cash and People & Well-Being
  • Support Global Utilities on project basis on Thermal related projects

Business Relationship management

  • Establish successful Ways of Working (WoW) between stakeholders and Procurement
  • Develop and execute ongoing communications with the stakeholders for the selected sourcing strategies and progress within area of spend responsibility
  • Manage the relationship with key supplier partner as part of the portfolio in the context of the Unilever Partner with Purpose (PWP) programme.

What You Need To Succeed

Experiences & Qualifications

Essential

  • Experienced (5+ years) in a procurement role
  • Experience in Utilities procurement areas
  • Experienced in setting up and managing complex supplier contracts
  • Skilled in delivering to challenging value delivery targets
  • A proven commercial operator and excellent negotiator
  • Experienced in stakeholder and supplier management
  • Strong communicator with experience in working successful in virtual team environments
  • Skilled at challenging business stakeholders and driving change

Skills

Skills/Competencies

  • Experience buying utilities (Electricity, Gas, Water, Renewable Energy) and managing decarbonization projects.
  • Specific experience in Thermal procurement including Natural Gas, Biomethane, Biomass, Biofuels, GPPA’s (Gas Power Purchase agreements) would be beneficial
  • Experience in engineering and renewable technologies is a plus
  • Ability to run Tenders, analyse sourcing data and conceptualise sourcing strategies to identify / propose sourcing opportunities while setting Portfolio strategy or developing negotiation strategies
  • Influencing skills to promote ideas and concepts back to stakeholders and budget holders in a Business Partner capacity
  • Attention to detail and ability to assimilate, appraise and extract information quickly when faced with increasing data inputs
  • Problem solving skills to analyse information to evaluate internal demand and external supplier information and extract critical cost opportunities
  • Thorough and astute preparation and approach for external contract negotiation
  • Financial understanding of the supplier cost models and lifetime cost of acquisition
  • Advanced negotiation abilities to develop win win situations with key suppliers
  • A Partner with Purpose (PWP) ambassador Innovative thinking to measure and promote supplier performance Curiosity to use, or suggest adaptions to, new technology to provide cost reducing or value creating support
  • Skilled at challenging business stakeholders and driving change
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English language.

Leadership

  • You are energized by delivering fantastic results. You are an example to others – both your results and your resilience. You are constantly on the lookout for better ways to do things, engaging and collaborating with others along the way.
  • As an individual you are the one responsible for your own wellbeing and delivering high standards of work. You must also focus on the Consumer and what they need. You are humble and have your head up, looking around to interpret evidence and data smartly, spot issues and opportunities to make things better.
  • Critical SOL (Standards of Leadership) Behaviors
  • PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE: Takes personal responsibility and accountability for execution and results. Generates intensity and focus to motivate people to deliver results at speed.
  • PERSONAL MASTERY: Sets high standards for themselves. Actively builds own wellbeing and resilience.
  • CONSUMER & CUSTOMER LOVE: Brings the voice of the consumer into everything we do, always.
  • PURPOSEFUL IMPACT: Has humility, understanding that leadership is service to others, inside and outside Unilever.
  • AGILITY: Explores the world around them, continually learning and developing their skills.
  • TALENT CATALYST: Inspire people to grow, with support and honesty.

Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life! This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity. 

What We Offer

  • Hybrid work and flexibility
  • Opportunities for the development and improvement of qualifications
  • Sharing the cost of professional training & courses

job_summary: Main Job Purpose: Responsible for leading the overall supply planning function for some of the SEAA countries ~10M EU GSV to UAPL. Customer Service and Business Partner to some markets from SEAA Supply Chain to support ~70M EU GSV to UAPL. This is a very exciting space for these markets with various portfolios getting added in and lots to learn and deliver for. Key job scope includes: Operational Supply Planning Capacity Interlocking to support business growth (both medium term and long term) Sourcing Network Optimization Inventory Planning Performance Management Customer Service Operations Order to Cash Management – Claims, Orders, Documents Key Accountabilities: Operational Supply Planning: Periodically liaise with sourcing units to review supply plans against confirmed customer orders. Consolidate supply plans from all sourcing units and share with customer service team. Identify short-term capacity issues and highlight the same to the business. Prepare contingency plans by offering products from alternate Sus. Loss Tree Analysis for all the non-supplied orders (e.g. forecast led loss, capacity led loss, material issues, etc.). KPI Review with the sourcing units at the end of each planning cycle (Service level, Supply plan compliance, Loss reasons, etc.) Feed supply plans and potential capacity issues to the demand planner to help in identifying the risks to the financial forecast as part of the S&OP cycle. Monitor and lead the offshore supply planning operations. Capacity Interlocking to support business growth Interlock 0-24 months capacity (medium term) with the sourcing units and cluster product group supply chain basis forecast received from the S&OP cycle. Interlock 2-5 yrs capacity (long term) with the Global Supply Chain team. Identify UI driven CapEx requirements basis discussions with Global Supply Chain team and feedback the same to UI business and finance team for appropriate evaluation and underwriting. Sourcing Network Optimization Sign off the UI sourcing strategy with the global supply chain team. Work with UI finance and Global Supply Chain teams to identify opportunities for sourcing network optimization basis predefined selection criteria (service, cost, etc) Drive supply chain cost reduction through sourcing network optimization. Inventory Planning Define the planning strategies at a ‘Customer–Sourcing Unit–SKU’ combination basis forecast and service criteria (Make to Forecast vs. Make to Order). Define stock holding principles for the Make to Forecast SKUs clearly categorizing the stock holding into relevant buckets (safety stock, cycle stock, buffer, etc.) Define stock replenishment guidelines and ordering frequency based on different planning cycles for each sourcing unit. Monitor DOH (Days On Hand) against target and identify improvement opportunities. SLOB management: Highlight slow moving and non-moving stocks to the business to take appropriate actions for disposal. Performance Management: Define and measure performance metrics for measuring effectiveness of the supply planning function. Service Strategy Segmented Supply Chain Design for service. Clearly define service strategy by vertical for the overall UI business (MTO vs. MTF by customer – SKU combination with the right stock holding location). Customer Service: To be the one point of contact for customers for all Supply Chain requirements. Be the lead person to run the Order to Deliver process (for a set of customers) and in the process ensure that customer’s requirements are met in the most cost- effective way and at the required speed. The main responsibilities of the job will include flawless execution of Customer Service in order to achieve business goals of Top & Bottom line growth specific to the Customer Groups. The incumbent will be responsible for delivery of Customer Service KPI's such as high fill rates, on-time deliveries of orders; reduction of losses due to Order To Cash (OTC) cycle. The incumbent will also be responsible lead digitization and capabilities relating to improving Customer Service strategy: Support in the implementation of Customer Service Strategy Customer Engagement: Business partner with Business Development Managers and Customer to unlock supply issues and servicing related concerns – dispatch plan, invoicing, claims, documentations, pre-payment process, etc. Monitor and track Fill Rates and devise improvement plan for key customers through Loss Tree analysis. Work with Capabilities team on several system/tools improvement projects. New lanes Set-up for UAPL sourced product ranges. Lead and manage the required set-ups to operationalize new lanes for transacting businesses for Unilever sourced products. Co-ordinate, track and report progress to stakeholders. Drive efficiencies to operationalize lanes fast including Customer Shipment Instructions (CSI) Order prioritization, backlog orders review, carry forward and exceptions’ management: Provide inputs to planning team for customer and order prioritization in case of constrained supplies. Handle exceptional orders and less than lead time orders as per the strategic needs of the business. Review Orders vs Supply Plan & communicate: Monitor Orders and communicate proactively with the customer on any potential issues in dispatching the perfect order. A less than perfect order has variance in qty or arrival time of any SKU from customer’s placed order. Connect with planning teams to resolve issues. Claims: All Supply Chain related claims, returns, refusals from the customer are to be handled appropriately. Lead the investigation and closure of cases. Review Invoices for approval Order accuracy & hygiene : Work with the customers to ensure that accurate orders are released to the planning team as per agreed timelines Provide timely feedbacks and updates to customer queries and circulate timely reports, conduct review meetings, calls on case to case and regular basis for smooth operations. Critical SOL (Standards of Leadership) Behaviours Care Deeply: You care deeply about how consumers experience our brands every day, everywhere; about our people’s growth and development and our impact on the planet. You care about our performance, to a point where it hurts when you don’t win. You apply fairness and transparency in what it takes to succeed and you hold positive tensions for bigger outcomes. Stay Three Steps ahead: You think boldly and creatively to make breakthroughs in performance. You are always curious and confident ─ anticipating and staying ahead of consumer needs and external trends to beat the competition, leading, shaping and disrupting the market Deliver with Excellence: You deliver everything you do with excellence and pace. You take personal ownership and hold each other to account. You take pride in execution, developing breakthrough solutions. Focus on what counts: You ruthlessly prioritise what really matters, allowing us to do better on fewer things. You set clear and stretching goals and recognise maximum performance impact. You challenge and debate on the right choices in order to deliver fewer, better things. Professional Skill: ESSENTIAL Bachelor’s degree in engineering or supply chain. PREFERRED Candidates with APICS certification. Experience Required: ESSENTIAL 4 to 5 yrs experience in Supply Chain out of which at least 3 yrs in supply planning Strong analytical skills and Strong Interpersonal skills Ability to work in fast paced environment and managing multiple stakeholders. Pro- active communication and ability to manage customer interactions Has a customer centric mindset with high influential skills to drive change and process improvement Ability to organize, structure and manage business partners in fast growing business Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities. job_summary: Job Title: MYSG Market Quality Ops Manager Work Location: Malaysia About The Role/brand The main purpose of the role is to drive the highest quality standards through the innovation process by ensuring compliance with our Unilever and factory specifications, standards and policies. The role will be focusing on ensuring the highest level of quality control and assurance activities in our laboratory and production environment. Who You Are And What You’ll Do You will be the customer and consumer-facing segment of the Quality organization, focused on Quality in the Go to Market operations, implementing, executing, improving, and ensuring compliance to Unilever standards and local and international regulatory standards, and providing technical quality support to customers, Marketing/Brand Building team for in market quality issues, care line support (complaint reporting and analysis), on-shelf assessments/improvements and incident/issue management and drives site Quality improvement activities to ensure product consumer safety and overall quality and address consumer/customer issues. The Go-to-Market (GtM) team is directly responsible for maintaining Quality Management system compliance in assembling operations and repacking operations, and supporting QMS compliance in Unilever sites, 3rd Party Manufacturer and warehouses as needed to meet marketplace needs. This includes participation in focused improvement teams in the relevant category or for the relevant customer. You’re a born leader: You will be a visible leader in the assigned category for the Quality community. Your actions will have a sizeable impact on the end to the end value chain. You will influence your colleagues and utilize world-class systems and tools to drive step-changes in demand planning performance. You’re a strategy guru: You will always be on your toes thinking of a Plan B and be ready to execute when needed. You will be an out-of-the-box thinker coming up with solutions to new problems whilst using your strategic influencing skills to convince the cross-functional team to execute. You’re a dot connector: You will be able to bridge the needs of different functions and expertly translate the requirements to keep the value chain in sync. You love to win, and have fun doing it: You play a critical and extremely tangible role in delivering results. You will help with rowing our leadership in the assigned category. Team Structure Reporting to: 1UL MYSG MM Quality Manager & MYSG Head of Supply Chain. Direct reports: N/A Indirect reports: N/A Your Role/Key Responsibilities Assist in ensuring compliance with our Unilever standards and Specifications and the effectiveness via the use of assessment/audit that supports the findings. Provide expertise, leadership, and support in Quality management for the resolution of Quality issues in re-packers, assemblers, promotions suppliers and customers within Malaysia. Provide technical information and advice to Customers and other departments, on product inquiries or complaints, process troubleshooting and Unilever policies and guidelines. Lead and support Quality Expert interventions (Operational Quality Reviews, HACCP workshops, Training events). Manage Halal JAKIM registration for products produced locally and coordinate with cross function team (Marketing, Research and Development, Planning) to provide document or information related with Halal registration. Support the development of Quality links to Multi-Country Organizations and Supply Chain GtM Strategy. Support and assist resolution of Quality issues with customers. Partners with Customer Business Development, Customer Service, associated Product Group Quality, factory, or warehouse team and takes proactive actions where needed. Support local marketplace product quality incident management and consequent actions. Conducts Incident management reporting per Unilever Incident Management requirements. Communicate local regulatory requirements and changes in partnership with the Local Legal department, Regulatory Affairs, Research and Development (R&D) and other teams to ensure compliance at manufacturing sites and with Logistics Quality to ensure compliance in warehousing and logistics. Protect the company from possible financial loss due to sub-standard ingredients and packaging material through effective testing and sampling programs. Assist with quality processes to ensure on-time releases of raw materials, packaging components and finished products. Plan, execute, and oversee market visit and performance for product safety & quality. Assist in continuous improvement initiatives and investigations related to quality defects. Quality representative for Innovation projects to drive compliance, growth, and consumer love. Internal Key Stakeholders: Supply Chain subfunctions (Customer Service, Planning, Procurement, Logistics), BB, Customer Business Development, R&D, RA, Legal, Unilever Food Solution team External Co-packer, Distributor, 3PL warehouse Travel 30 % of the time for travelling to conduct product-market assessment, distributor and Copacker audit. What You’ll Need To Succeed University degree in a technical discipline or general sciences (Food Science, Biology, Engineering, Microbiology, Chemistry). Minimum 10 years relevant/equivalent experience with strong exposure to Quality, Consumer Safety, Health and Environmental management systems in a food and beverage manufacturing facility and an office setting. Minimum 5-7 years of experience in Supply Chain Quality or R&D, additional experience in Manufacturing a plus. You are knowledgeable in quality/food safety programs including HACCP, SSOP, Allergen Management Food Safety and Integrated Pest Management. You are a Halal executive certificate holder and knowledgeable in Halal registration with JAKIM. You are an affinity for change management and digital solutions. You demonstrated proven effectiveness in collaboration and communication with multi-stakeholders. You demonstrated project and information management skills. You are proficient in computer skills with MS Office Applications (Excel, PowerPoint, and Power Apps). Your ability to think and act across functions and along with processes, strong Growth mindset. How To Apply Please apply online and add your updated resume. Your application will be reviewed against our requirements and we will be in touch to provide you with an update on the status of your application if shortlisted. About Unilever Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose-led business. Work with brands that are well-loved around the world, that improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas, and disrupt processes: use your energy to make this happen. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best. Every day, many Malaysian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life-giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future. Every individual here can bring their purpose to life through their work. Join us and you will be surrounded by inspiring leaders and supportive peers. Who You Are And What You’ll Do

This individual should have a strong background in continuous improvement methodology, such as Lean, Six Sigma, TPM, etc, in order to: drive process improvement and team development through the implementation of The Magnum Ice Cream Company techniques; establish a world class manufacturing environment in which employees have a framework of operating systems based on the methodology that guide their way of working; coordinate and/or conduct training based on the processes; and foster a cultural change towards self-directed teams.

Key focus areas for continuous improvement will be in the realm of safety for our people and for our product, waste reduction, improved efficiency, zero defects, zero environmental loss, and customer satisfaction. In addition, as an employee, you are encouraged, to participate in company volunteer projects, community service initiatives, and social mission teams.

What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be

  • Driving current and future manufacturing performance in the areas of Safety, Quality, Productivity, Cost, Delivery and Morale
  • Oversee activities of the site; Communicate, investigate and address problems and situations, actively engaging in improving the site’s performance.
  • Facilitate the development of the shift employees through training, coaching, feedback, and performance management
  • Supervise the manufacture of quality products to meet product specifications in accordance with GMP, SPC, and manufacturing specifications.
  • Recommend and review staffing needs to achieve production schedules
  • Ensure a safe work environment exists by implementing and maintaining work safety standards, training and bringing action plans to closure.
  • Prepare, maintain and analyze manufacturing reports related to quality, efficiency, waste & attainment through Loss Tree approach
  • Consistently administer company policy and practices
  • Continually improve the quality of each area through process innovation and methods improvement
  • Plan and execute plant trials for new product innovations
  • Membership and active participation on the Hazmat team is a requirement of this role
  • Other projects and duties as assigned

What You Will Need To Succeed

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or other applicable field required or additional experience in lieu of degree
  • Must have a minimum of 2 years of supervisory/lead experience in manufacturing environment; food manufacturing preferred
  • Demonstrated knowledge, skills and abilities through experience in production, materials management is required
  • Must have experience in UMS, Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, or other continuous improvement program
  • Effectively lead, coach, and motivate team members towards an autonomous team environment
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to handle interpersonal issues effectively and influence others through a matrixed environment is required
  • Must have the ability to manage projects and project teams from inception to completion including hitting deadlines and communicating progress
  • Working knowledge of Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and ability to drive improvements using the Loss Tree is required
  • SAP and warehouse management skills / experience preferred

Looking for Your Dream Job? Join Our Ice Cream Team As Logistics Manager!

Scope: Nordic

Location: Stockholm/Solna Head Office

Terms & Conditions: Full Time

The Ice Cream division at Unilever is preparing to stand on its own, aiming to become an independent, EUR 8.3 billion publicly listed company by the end of 2025. We’re on a mission to create the ultimate snacking company. A place where growth, innovation, founder and ownership mentality, and performance are cultivated and rewarded. And where we craft extraordinary ice cream experiences - transforming ordinary moments into lasting memories. Because we know, life tastes better with ice cream.

About The Magnum Ice Cream Company

The Magnum Ice Cream Company is all about growth. Growing our business. Growing our customers’ businesses. Growing our people’s careers. Growth begins with empowerment. So we free our people to be innovative, responsible entrepreneurs, driven and equipped to give our consumers more amazing products and unforgettable moments – and having fun doing it.

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry. We have been taking pleasure seriously for more than 100 years, serving happiness with every lick or scoop of ice cream for generations.

We are investing to unlock the full growth potential of The Magnum Ice Cream Company as a standalone entity, once we separate from Unilever, which is planned to happen before the end of 2025.

We dream big but keep things simple to act fast.

If you want to grow with us, make an impact, and shape the future of Ice Cream, this is the place for you!

As TMICC Nordic Logistics Manager, you are responsible for logistics operations, master plan development and execution in the Nordic region. The logistics network consists of frozen warehouses in Denmark, Sweden, and Finland. You are also responsible of running the daily operations with logistics team located across the different Nordic countries and our 3PL partners and you are the budget owner for logistics cost.

You play a key role in making sure we have a cost-effective repacking portfolio which serves the business needs and an efficient process of creating new repacks.

In Short You Are Responsible Of

  • People management and development of the Nordic logistics & repacking team
  • Master plan development and execution
  • Logistics KPIs and solving any operational issues in the network
  • Integrate logistics objectives to Nordic supply chain strategy and be a member of the Nordic supply chain lead team
  • Competitive and sustainable Logistics Cost (CPT) for the Nordics, including RTM

Main Tasks

Customer Orientation and Supply of Goods

  • Ensure reliable and efficient supply of goods to customers from the distribution centers (DCs).
  • Adhere to agreed service levels and adjust logistics to changing customer needs, for retails, distributors and e-commerce
  • Develop a flexible distribution network prepared for capacity expansions and changing market demands.

Logistics Management and Responsibility

  • Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and legal standards in the DCs and logistics processes.
  • Overall responsibility for secondary transportation, warehousing, and logistic cost and service in the Nordics.
  • Define, organize and execute roadmap (short and mid term) - together with the Europe logistic team, plan and manage the WH budget and investment management (CapEx) to achieve cost-cash-service goals.
  • Supervise and implement the Sweden warehouse project as part of Europe supply chain transformation (BigHero wave1)
  • Co-lead the regular 2Y transport tenders process and implement any new changes within the operations
  • Responsible for annual inventories and regular stock reconciliations.
  • Connect with logistic providers, Genpact and TMICC European logistic team to guarantee a smooth execution of product delivery with specific focus during the ice cream seasonality peaks.

Analysis and Optimization

  • Develop structured plans for continuous improvement of safety, quality, service, costs, cash and sustainability.
  • Use data-driven approaches to identify and implement savings potentials.
  • Introduce and scale best practices from internal and external sources to increase the efficiency and competitiveness of logistics.

Safety Management and Collaboration

  • Ensure the highest safety standards at the sites according to Security and SHE guidelines, quality assurance requirements, and legal regulations.
  • Support safety metrics and measures to prevent accidents and monitor implementation by the teams.
  • Promote solution-oriented collaboration in cross-functional teams to achieve strategic goals.
  • Close collaboration with internal logistics teams (Nordics, Europe) and external partners, including transport service providers, to manage tenders and long-term projects.

Leadership and Project Management

  • Provide a proactive approach to solve operational issue with the capability to balance short term operational intensity and long-term structural solutions.
  • Lead projects, risk/opportunity assessment, as well as reporting and communication.
  • Ensure a customer-centric perspective in strategic decisions and project initiatives.

What You Need To Be Successful

Professional Expertise

  • Deep knowledge in supply chain management, especially in warehousing, distribution, and transportation.
  • Experience in budget and project management (including CapEx) as well as cost optimization.
  • Experience with logistics best practices, continuous process improvement, and data-driven management.

Analytical and Strategic Skills

  • Strong analytical skills to identify efficiency potentials and derive strategic measures.
  • Ability to develop and implement long-term logistics strategies that balance cost, cash, service and sustainability.
  • Experience dealing with complex requirements and dynamic market conditions.

Leadership and Communication Strength

  • Excellent communication skills in English to operate cross-functionally and internationally. Swedish and/or Denish language knowledge would be a plus.
  • Team player with experience in coordinating internal and external partners.
  • Leadership competence and assertiveness, combined with a solution-oriented approach.

Personal Attributes and Mindset

  • Safety and quality-conscious actions with a focus on compliance with legal and internal company standards.
  • Proactive, structured working style with strong initiative and problem-solving skills.
  • Enthusiasm for innovation and the ability to develop creative solutions for current and future logistical challenges.
  • At least 3 years of experience in logistics, planning, or supply chain customer operations.

Passion for High Performance: The role requires the consistent optimization of logistics processes to ensure the highest safety standards, cost efficiency, and service levels in the distribution centers.

Personal Mastery: A structured, data-driven approach and a solution-oriented working style are crucial to mastering complex logistical challenges.

Business Acumen: The responsibility includes budget and CapEx management as well as the strategic development of warehousing and transport networks to ensure competitiveness.

Consumer Love: Designing flexible, customer-oriented logistics systems allows for meeting changing requirements and market needs.

What You Can Expect

  • A unique mix of global scale & start-up spirit—€8.3bn powerhouse with an agile, entrepreneurial mindset. We’re building a new high growth Ice Cream company from the ground up.
  • Career without limits—42 markets, international opportunities, and fast tracked growth.
  • A performance-driven culture—Freedom to act, disrupt and grow – your success is measured by impact.
  • A company that celebrates joy, innovation, and purpose—We create extraordinary careers, just like our ice cream creates extraordinary moments.

Additional Information

As publicly announced, Unilever will separate its Ice Cream business which is expected by the end of 2025. This role will transfer to the new Ice Cream company.

This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity.

Vị trí của cấp quản lý trực tiếp: Trưởng Phòng Kinh Doanh Khu Vực


Địa điểm làm việc: Theo sự điều động từ Công ty


Vai Trò Trách Nhiệm Chung


Hoạch định chiến lược kinh doanh hằng ngày của nhà phân phối (NPP)/ Ngành hàng được phân công và thực hiện kế hoạch đó theo các chính sách, quy trình của công ty nhằm đạt được:


  • Doanh số mua vào (Primary Sales), doanh số bán ra (Secondary Sales)
  • Số lượng cửa hàng cần bao phủ
  • Mức độ bao phủ của từng sản phẩm tại cửa hàng
  • Việc trưng bày, khuyến mãi hàng hóa tại ngoài thị trường


Trực tiếp tham gia việc tuyển dụng, đào tạo (on-boarding), huấn luyện và quản lý thành tích của đội ngũ nhân viên tại NPP.


Các Công Việc Chính


  • Xây dựng, phân chia tuyến bán hàng (beatplan), vẽ sơ đồ tuyến bán hàng (beatmap) theo quy định của công ty.
  • Tiến hành khảo sát và cập nhật danh sách khách hàng vào hệ thống quản lý NPP (DMS) ngay khi có thay đổi để đảm bảo tính chính xác của dữ liệu.
  • Xây dựng và phát triển mối quan hệ khách hàng tại thị trường được phân công.
  • Thực thi tất cả các chương trình khuyến mãi và chương trình trưng bày theo đúng quy định của công ty nhằm đạt những mục tiêu đề ra.
  • Nắm bắt tình hình của các sản phẩm cùng ngành hàng và cập nhật với Giám Đốc Điều Hành NPP và Quản lý trực tiếp để có những kế hoạch kịp thời.
  • Các công việc liên quan đến quản lý địa bàn được quản lý trực tiếp phân bổ thông qua các buổi họp tập trung hay email.
  • Đại diện cho Unilever tại NPP, bàn bạc và thiết lập kế hoạch phối hợp kinh doanh với NPP theo từng tháng/quý/năm với sự đồng ý của Trưởng Phòng Bán hàng.
  • Xem xét và chỉnh sửa bản kế hoạch này hằng quý. Làm việc với Giám Đốc Điều Hành NPP/ Chủ NPP để đảm bảo việc kinh doanh của NPP (vốn đầu tư, trang thiết bị, lợi nhuận...) theo đúng quy chuẩn của Unilever và đảm bảo các chính sách, quy chế của Unilever được áp dụng đúng đủ.
  • Làm việc với Giám Đốc Điều Hành NPP/ Chủ NPP để lên đơn hàng phù hợp với tình hình kinh doanh và chiến lược công ty nhằm hỗ trợ NPP đạt chỉ tiêu bán hàng hàng tháng.
  • Lên lịch đi thị trường hàng tuần và thực hiện việc đi thị trường theo lịch để giám sát, quản lý thị trường, khách hàng và huấn luyện nhân viên.
  • Tham gia tuyển dụng, đào tạo, huấn luyện và quản lý thành tích nhân viên NPP. Các công việc liên quan đến quản lý NPP được quản lý trực tiếp phân bổ qua các buổi họp tập trung hay email.
  • Giám sát, đào tạo và huấn luyện Tổ Trưởng NPP, nhân viên NPP Làm việc với Giám Đốc Điều Hành NPP đề giải quyết các vấn đề than phiền, khiếu nại của khách hàng trong phạm vi quyền hạn cho phép.
  • Đề nghị những giải pháp, sáng kiến để phát triển thị trường được giao dựa trên những am hiểu của bản thân về thị trường với Giám Đốc Điều Hành NPP và Quản lý trực tiếp.
  • Thực thi những kế hoạch này sau khi đã có sự đồng ý cùa Quản Lý Trực Tiếp.

  • Ít nhất 2 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí quản lí/giám sát nhà phân phối.

  • Khả năng làm việc nhóm tốt. Kỹ năng lãnh đạo, quản lý và phát triển con người.


Chỉ tiêu đánh giá thành tích và năng lực:


  • Các chỉ tiêu đã thống nhất với quản lý trực tiếp và được ghi nhận trong hệ thống đánh giá hiệu quả công việc của công ty.

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world.
