Our strategy begins with a purpose that places consumers at the heart of everything we do: Brighten everyday life for all. Our goal is to deliver best-in-class performance with market-making, unmissably superior brands. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world. At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our collaborative, and flexible working environment. Our organizational ambition centers around creating workplaces that foster equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging across all aspects of our business. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

About Procurement

Part of the Supply Chain family, Procurement is responsible for over 30B Euro of material and services spend globally with more than 60,000 suppliers. Getting the right services and materials, sustainably sourced and ensuring responsible procurement is critical to ensuring our brands with purpose grow. Our teams work closely with the business to understand stakeholders needs, bring innovation to meet changing consumer, employees and customers needs, and drive financial value for Unilever through competitive buying. We’re at the forefront of digital procurement, bringing new tools and analytics to drive data-based decisions. Our strategy is ‘Procurement with Purpose’ and focuses on buying responsibly, buying better, and growing together with partners around the world. Our ambition is based on three key drivers: being Purpose-Led, Value-Driven, and Future-Fit.

Job Purpose

The Category Procurement team is the face of the business to the Portfolio Procurement teams (buyers) and suppliers and the face of procurement to the full cross functional team, such as Marketing, Supply Chain, R&D, etc. In the position, you will be supporting and representing Procurement to the specific Category in Europe. Be ready to get exposed and out of your comfort zone! You will be directly exposed to all major functions and to the regional category leadership team frequently.

If you are looking for a “step-up” on your learning, see pressure as motivation, enjoy negotiations (internal and external), want to have an E2E business mindset, love sustainability, love people interaction, love project management, love people development… This role will create high visibility across different functions and can be a great step for future careers both within Procurement as well as with the other functions we work closely with. So come join us!

Procurement

WHAT WILL YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES BE:

  • Execute buying strategy aligned with the EU and global strategy business needs
  • Supplier Relationship Management responsibility and accountability.
  • Support the Procurement Packaging Manager for the global or regional negotiations or even lead some local tender & negotiations on specific parts of the EU Decoration portfolio
  • You will need to constantly develop suppliers and new origins needed in line with business growth and innovation priorities.
  • Communicate and execute the supply strategies and maintain connections with key Business Units/Business Groups.
  • Follow market conditions, and lead price forecasting cycles.
  • Execute contract negotiations, leveraging the business and digital tools for support as needed.
  • Support the business with accurate price forecasting. Prepare information on purchase prices and conditions to enable proper budgeting and cash forecasting.
  • Drive portfolio management together with the relevant material expert teams to deliver portfolio excellence in specifications management, formulation and blend flexibility and other R&D pillars.
  • Support the Cash Flow and Working Capital plans for the portfolios.
  • Manage supply chain issues (e.g. crisis management) involving stakeholders as needed.

Innovation / Rejuvenation Projects

  • Participate in cross functional project teams for Innovation and Rejuvenation as the Procurement partner
  • Lead Procurement input for decision making at leadership team level (innovation gatekeeping meetings for example) e.g. pricing of materials, risk statements, lead times, savings potentials and financial impact
  • Brief Portfolio Procurement on upcoming innovations and initiate contracting requests to the buyers,
  • Identify (new) raw and pack materials introduced by Innovation projects together with business partners and ensure timely introduction, at a competitive price, ensuring supplier selection is in line with our Procurement Strategies and with sufficient capacity for growth
  • As part of OTIF project delivery follow-up with Portfolio Procurement and suppliers to secure supplier capacity and capability for strategic growth and ensure contract creation and 1st delivery in a timely manner to meet first production dates

5S / Value Improvement

  • Act as the procurement interface for the Category team’s 5S related activities.
  • Support on delivering the material cost savings target via Smart Buying and Smart Product and building the strategic roadmap for the value improvement workstream, in line with USLP strategy.
  • Support on 5S projects (e.g. alternative supplier approvals, material changes) and ensure they are recorded by the Procurement Portfolio teams in our savings reporting systems.

Other

  • Support ASA/ AMA (alternative supplier/alternative material) projects delivery for either resilience or 5S reasons
  • Support on regulatory related topics (e.g. origin of materials, regulatory changes that may impact business and category)
  • Support Procurement Operations with insights from business
  • Lead/support Sustainability projects (ex. better, less and no plastic agenda)

Internal

This role will interface with the following stakeholders:

  • Procurement:
  • Procurement portfolios (global and regional)
  • Procurement operations (global and regional)
  • Collaborative manufacture
  • Sustainability teams
  • Supply Chain (P&I, Manufacturing, Planning)
  • R&D (RDC, GDC, MET, TPLs)
  • Marketing
  • Finance (Category, Procurement)
  • CCBT teams
  • Quality
  • AW team

External

  • Suppliers

What You Need To Succeed

Experience & Qualifications:

  • University/Bachelor degree or relevant experience
  • Minimum 3 years working experience in Procurement or Supply Chain (preferably within category procurement)
  • Experience in Procurement and/or Innovation Management preferably in FMCG
  • Experience of working in cross functional project teams
  • Basic understanding of Finance
  • Experience within MS Office and SAP will be of a great value

Skills

  • Self Management (priority setting, risk analysis, resources)
  • Take ownership and responsibility; have energy and drive
  • Be result and solution oriented
  • Networking and relationship management
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Analytical skills
  • Project management skills
  • Drive for team alignment; be able to work in networks; be able to work independently
  • Ability to work in virtual teams
  • Good understanding of business economics
  • Supply Market Intelligence and Analysis - Collecting Relevant Information; Analyzing Supply and Demand Market Behavior and Understanding Key Cost Drivers & Price Trends
  • Managing Partnerships and Relationships (e.g. managing the ongoing relationship to deliver value to the business)

Leadership

  • You are energized by delivering fantastic results. You are an example to others – both your results and your resilience. You are constantly on the lookout for better ways to do things, engaging and collaborating with others along the way.
  • As an individual you are the one responsible for your own wellbeing and delivering high standards of work. You must also focus on the Consumer and what they need. You are humble and have your head up, looking around to interpret evidence and data smartly, spot issues and opportunities to make things better.

SOL (Standards of Leadership) Behaviours

  • PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE: Takes personal responsibility and accountability for execution and results. Generates intensity and focus to motivate people to deliver results at speed.
  • PERSONAL MASTERY: Sets high standards for themselves. Actively builds own wellbeing and resilience.
  • CONSUMER & CUSTOMER LOVE: Brings the voice of the consumer into everything we do, always.
  • PURPOSEFUL IMPACT: Has humility, understanding that leadership is service to others, inside and outside Unilever.
  • AGILITY: Explores the world around them, continually learning and developing their skills.
  • TALENT CATALYST: Inspire people to grow, with support and honesty.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid work and flexibility.
  • Opportunities for the development and improvement of qualifications.
  • Sharing the cost of professional training & courses.
  • Benefits: life insurance, private medical care, pension fund, sharing the cost of sports activities, Benefits System – Cafeteria and many others.
  • Extra days off to take care of yourself and others.
  • Unilever store - Our products at attractive prices.

job_description_formatted:
About Unilever

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

About Procurement

Part of the Supply Chain family, Procurement is responsible for over 30B Euro of material and services spend globally with more than 60,000 suppliers, over half of them in MBS. Getting the right services and materials, sustainably sourced and ensuring responsible procurement is critical to ensuring our brands with purpose grow. Our teams work closely with the business to understand stakeholders needs, bring innovation to meet changing consumer, employees’, and customers’ needs, and drive financial value for Unilever through competitive buying. We’re at the forefront of digital procurement, bringing new tools and analytics to drive data-based decisions.

Our strategy is ‘Procurement with Purpose’ and focuses on buying responsibly, buying better, and growing together with partners around the world. Our ambition is based on three key drivers: being Purpose-Led, Value-Driven, and Future-Fit.

Within Capex and Utilities, the Assistant Procurement Manager Utilities & Decarbonization is responsible for the sourcing strategy development, implementation, and procurement in the Utilities procurement category for their geography. This role will be responsible to achieve our decarbonization strategy to Scope 1, 2 and 3 (Green House Gas (GHG) emissions that the company makes directly and indirectly in all value chain) from a Procurement standpoint in support of our business strategy covering European region. This role forms a key business partner with Supply chain, Sustainability team and Engineering at supply chain sites.

The Assistant Procurement Manager will increase efficiency of our Utiliites and Decarbonisation procurement by driving scale where it makes sense, decreasing fragmentation, pooling expertise across European region, prioritizing higher impact spend areas, leveraging technology and data, and delivering on best practices.

Job Purpose

Unilever is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. If you are willing to join a strong passionate multicultural team and contribute directly to the Unilever Decarbonization commitments then this role is just for you!

What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be

  • Specialist for Electricity Procurement, including on site Solar, PPA’s (Power Purchase agreements)
  • Be accountable for the implementation of the Utilities and Decarbonization Procurement strategies and best practices across EU
  • Support and guide the procurement organization across EU’s Factories to meet goals and objectives in support of the overall Unilever Strategy
  • Pro-actively engage with the utility & decarbonization procurement leads and peers to understand the strategic plan in their region and drive best practices
  • To build and maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders and user communities across Unilever business by being the critical point of contact for Europe
  • Engage with key suppliers (Utilities, Decarbonization) and develop understanding of their capabilities and solutions. Be aware of industry key drivers, new technologies and new sustainability capabilities.
  • Help develop and execute ongoing communications with the business for the selected sourcing strategies and progress
  • Support identifying opportunities across Supply Chain and their connections with Utilities, Decarbonization, Renewable Sources
  • To take ownership on and lead projects in procurement across the key areas of Partnership with Purpose (PWP), Responsible Partner Policy (RPP), Sustainability, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), Savings, Cash and People & Well-Being
  • Support Global Utilities on project basis on Electricity related projects

Business Relationship management

  • Establish successful Ways of Working (WoW) between stakeholders and Procurement
  • Develop and execute ongoing communications with the stakeholders for the selected sourcing strategies and progress within area of spend responsibility
  • Manage the relationship with key supplier partner as part of the portfolio in the context of the Unilever Partner with Purpose (PWP) programme.

What You Need To Succeed

Experiences & Qualifications

Essential

  • Experienced (5+ years) in a procurement role
  • Experience in Utilities procurement areas
  • Experienced in setting up and managing complex supplier contracts
  • Skilled in delivering to challenging value delivery targets
  • A proven commercial operator and excellent negotiator
  • Experienced in stakeholder and supplier management
  • Strong communicator with experience in working successful in virtual team environments
  • Skilled at challenging business stakeholders and driving change

Skills

Skills/Competencies

  • Experience buying utilities (Electricity, Gas, Water, Renewable Energy) and managing decarbonization projects.
  • Specific experience in Electricity procurement including onsite PV, offsite PPA’s would be beneficial
  • Experience in engineering and renewable technologies is a plus
  • Ability to run Tenders, analyse sourcing data and conceptualise sourcing strategies to identify / propose sourcing opportunities while setting Portfolio strategy or developing negotiation strategies
  • Influencing skills to promote ideas and concepts back to stakeholders and budget holders in a Business Partner capacity
  • Attention to detail and ability to assimilate, appraise and extract information quickly when faced with increasing data inputs
  • Problem solving skills to analyse information to evaluate internal demand and external supplier information and extract critical cost opportunities
  • Thorough and astute preparation and approach for external contract negotiation
  • Financial understanding of the supplier cost models and lifetime cost of acquisition
  • Advanced negotiation abilities to develop win win situations with key suppliers
  • A Partner with Purpose (PWP) ambassador Innovative thinking to measure and promote supplier performance Curiosity to use, or suggest adaptions to, new technology to provide cost reducing or value creating support
  • Skilled at challenging business stakeholders and driving change
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English language.

Leadership

  • You are energized by delivering fantastic results. You are an example to others – both your results and your resilience. You are constantly on the lookout for better ways to do things, engaging and collaborating with others along the way.
  • As an individual you are the one responsible for your own wellbeing and delivering high standards of work. You must also focus on the Consumer and what they need. You are humble and have your head up, looking around to interpret evidence and data smartly, spot issues and opportunities to make things better.
  • Critical SOL (Standards of Leadership) Behaviors
  • PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE: Takes personal responsibility and accountability for execution and results. Generates intensity and focus to motivate people to deliver results at speed.
  • PERSONAL MASTERY: Sets high standards for themselves. Actively builds own wellbeing and resilience.
  • CONSUMER & CUSTOMER LOVE: Brings the voice of the consumer into everything we do, always.
  • PURPOSEFUL IMPACT: Has humility, understanding that leadership is service to others, inside and outside Unilever.
  • AGILITY: Explores the world around them, continually learning and developing their skills.
  • TALENT CATALYST: Inspire people to grow, with support and honesty.

Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life! This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity. 

What We Offer

  • Hybrid work and flexibility
  • Opportunities for the development and improvement of qualifications
  • Sharing the cost of professional training & courses
  • Benefits: life insurance, private medical care, pension fund, sharing the cost of sports activities, Benefits System – Cafeteria and many others
  • Extra days off to take care of yourself and others
  • Unilever store - Our products at attractive prices

Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! Thus if you require any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of your application so that we can support you through your recruitment journey.

Unilever Food Solutions (UFS) PH aims to achieve PHP6B in 2024 and achieve 15% YOY growth from hereon + foodservice division of Unilever. It leads the dynamic Food Service market across its categories and has ambitious growth objectives, marketing a range of professional savoury, dressings products and services to chefs across the country.

Currently UFS relies on sales reps visiting chefs to generate demand. Broadcast communication mediums are not yet developed, which limits the pace of growth. Digital offers a huge opportunity and future growth for UFS depends on evolving the business model and developing contact strategies to reach the 95% of operators we do not visit. Ambitious targets to transform our business towards a more digitally advanced one have been agreed with the Global board and set in motion.

Main Purpose Of The Job

As Data & Business Technology Manager, they will be responsible for managing team members under Data Analytics & Tech Team and provide strategy/ roadmap supporting the topline and profit ambition of the country.

  • They will be building the culture of digital transformation through a Future-Fit UFS PH to drive topline and profit.
  • They will be managing the automated monitoring & processes, platform integration, single customer view, customer lifetime value
  • They will be managing the reporting & dashboarding, running data models, managing the local database and increasing impact with the dedicated business efforts (funnel approach). (S)he will be closely involved in integrating the full data infrastructure.
  • They will oversee the development and use of technology, data systems, monitor and analyze information and technology systems, and ensure that data systems and technology meet company standards for accuracy and compliance.

Main Accountabilities

Data Analysis & Insighting

  • Creates insights by executing & using sales figure interpretation models. Analysis is performed based on globally developed data models by data scientists. Also liaises with data scientists to optimize existing models.
  • Maintains fully-profiled operators (FPO) and reports status to CD Team to take action. Delivers qualified leads to CD Team.
  • Makes sure all leads are transferred to the system and are followed-up correctly and in due time
  • Refine lead prioritization system (eOTM) to assess and lead scoring to estimate likelihood of purchase)
  • Assess and recommend more effective persona segmentation model across the entire funnel
  • Support campaign automation via Marketo by managing data flows from other platforms
  • Develop and refine predictive analytics for applications like recommendation engines, food trend predictions, fall out account alerts.

Data Visualization & Reporting

  • Translates data into BI at the top and end of the funnel based on the grip-grab-grow model by delivering advice to CDLT, UFSLT and the Digital team. Focus on acquisition of new businesses and win-back of lost operators.
  • Delivers and manages the dashboards needed to visualize BI to the rest of the organisation.

Data Management

  • Owns the process to integrate all sales, marketing and digital data into the local data infrastructure.
  • Integrate CD IT infrastructure into the wider data infrastructure according to the business needs and the chosen strategy
  • Harness the value of data through cleaning; organizing from all touchpoints
  • Is the gatekeeper of data quality and integrity as required by the business.

Interface Management

  • Needs to have a strong network with all customer-facing roles in the country
  • Maintains relationships with Trade-partners to secure the flow of SSD into the systems
  • Close coordination with Global Data team on data capture and ingestion of operator data. Collaborate with Global Data Team on defining the requirements for data capabilities, interfaces, tools, models and building capabilities as required.
  • Gatekeeper and management of the Local Data Area (Data Lake)/ Universal Data Lake (UDL) for the country

Tech Management

  • Contribute to and implement standards and changes to systems and processes.
  • Analyze complex data systems (data elements, data flow, relationships, and dependencies).
  • Support enterprise-wide compliance with enterprise standards, processes, and policies.
  • Implement and support approach to drive Technology Risk functions, including documented processes, risks, and controls, and providing reporting of status.
  • Document functional specifications, plan and schedule projects, and lead a team of professionals through implementation.
  • Balance projects that add immediate value with longer-term initiatives.
  • Recommend buy vs. build decisions or what needs to be outsourced.

Qualifications And Relevant Experience

  • Expert knowledge of SQL, Excel and general database skills
  • Knowledge with statistical models/ tools
  • Strong communication skills and capability to be data thought leader to convey crucial data easilty
  • Conversion and result-driven
  • Knowledge of the content & structure of the database and end to end flow of tech/ systems
  • Team player that can work cross-functional (with UFSLT, CD, Marketing, data technology teams, 3P supporting data, tools, Customer Service, etc)
  • Knowledge of handling sales figures
  • Fluent English communication skills, verbal & written
  • Influencing all necessary stakeholders to deploy all business requirements in line with the strategy
  • Ability to create reporting which is accessible, usable and highly focused on delivering insights
  • Ability to explain the data in a super simple way to stakeholders in the company & understand their business needs
  • Able to analyse & collect business insights to teams so they can have a bigger impact with the limited resources available
  • Knowledge of API integrations & setting up future-proof data infrastructures in line with the business strategy
  • With a passion for learning and creating Adhoc materials for all channels
  • Has the leadership skills to manage Data & Customer Service Excellence Team
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience with Armstrong, LE, SAP, data lake and/or digital (CRM) tools
  • Passion for data and customer service
  • Experience with reporting (PowerBI), advanced Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Flow, others

Unilever is currently hiring for Personal Care Indonesia Assistant CMI Manager Skin Cleansing and Baby Care based in Grha Unilever, Indonesia

About Unilever

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

Job Purpose

Unilever is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. If you are a person that live, breathe, and speak consumers for the betterment of consumers’ life, then this role is just for you!

Main Responsibilities

  • To support the line manager in monitoring on market, category and brand performance to get what is behind the metrics and what business partners should do
  • To support the line manager primarily brand deployment post evaluation and collaborate with BG CMI in brand development mix evaluation through consumer research and understanding
  • To support the line manager in partnering primarily Marketing team in day-to-day basis, and BU Leadership team (cross function) on a larger scale
  • To support the line manager in bridging connection, collaboration and drive one CMI point of view between Business Group and Business Unit
  • Scope: SCL and Baby Care Indonesia; Brands: Lifebuoy, Lux, Dove, GAL, Citra, Zwitsal

Candidate Criteria

Experience & Qualification

  • Graduated from reputable university (local or overseas)
  • At least 2-3 years in brand development and/or brand deployment role in CMI (preferably) or Marketing side in FMCG/Digital/Ecommerce business, or in reputable research agencies
  • Solid experience in leading consumer research projects (exploratory studies, concept, product, pack, communication, post launch evaluation)
  • Solid experience in leading and analyzing brand measurement studies
  • Experience in working with global team is a plus

Skill

  • Strong in capturing and representing consumer voice
  • Strong in analytical thinking, creative mindset, and storytelling
  • Highly flexible, easy to adapt
  • Not so `boring` person – having hidden talent or unique interest is a plus
  • Fluent in spoken and written English
  • Strong in presentation and communication skills
  • Strong in qualitative and quantitative studies
  • Familiar with main agencies tools (ie from Nielsen and Kantar) and research methods
  • Familiar with AI based tools and Power BI is a must

Leadership

  • You are energized by delivering fantastic results. You are an example to others – both your results and your resilience. You are constantly on the lookout for better ways to do things, engaging and collaborating with others along the way.
  • As an individual you are the one responsible for your own wellbeing and delivering high standards of work. You must also focus on the Consumer and what they need. You are humble and have your head up, looking around to interpret evidence and data smartly, spot issues and opportunities to make things better.

Critical SOL (Standards of Leadership) Behaviors

  • PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE: Takes personal responsibility and accountability for execution and results. Has an owner’s mindset, using data and insight to make decisions.
  • PERSONAL MASTERY: Sets high standards for themselves. Actively builds own wellbeing and resilience.
  • CONSUMER LOVE: Whatever their role, always looks for better ways to serve consumers. Invests time inside and outside to understand the needs of consumers.
  • PURPOSE & SERVICE: Has humility, understanding that leadership is service to others, inside and outside Unilever.
  • AGILITY: Explores the world around them, continually learning and developing their skills.

Note: Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicates from all walks of life! We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a positive, barrier-free recruitment journey. If you require any support to complete your application or any subsequent stage throughout your recruitment journey with us at Unilever, then please specify how we may be able to assist you.

The role will be based in Grha Unilever Indonesia and will be partnering two categories: SCL and Baby Care

job_description_formatted:
About Unilever

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

Job Purpose

Unilever is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. If you are someone who is passionate, who works well with others, and is a master at building partnerships, then come join Unilever’s Procurement team!

CATEGORY/FUNCTION INTRODUCTION

Be a part of Unilever’s journey to become a global leader in sustainability and landing a future-fit business model that drives superior performance. The Unilever procurement team is an integral part of achieving these goals.

The packaging portfolio will require an innovative thinker who can create value and think outside the box. Due to the nature of the packaging portfolio, this role has high complexity and needs structured management of many suppliers, markets, and/or packaging solutions.

Our suppliers are at the heart of everything we do. We need to work more closely than ever with suppliers to co-create sustainable practices and bigger and better initiatives with positive impact. This will be key to delivering value in this role.

As Unilever procurement adapts to the ever-dynamic business environment, we will need to be agile to continue our track record of delivery bottom and top line of our businesses.

What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be

  • To deliver cost savings and value creation
  • Ensuring supplier compliance to Unilever standards
  • Contribute towards Unilever’s sustainability commitments and delivery of targets (e.g. plastics, deforestation, climate, living wage, etc.)
  • Support global and regional buying strategy development to support business needs
  • Develop and cultivate a proper supplier relationship management program
  • Constantly identify and develop suppliers and new origins to deliver business growth and innovation priorities
  • Communicate and execute the supply strategies and maintain connections with key Business Units and Business Groups
  • Lead and support global and/or regional negotiations
  • Execute contract negotiations, leveraging the business and digital tools for support as needed
  • Follow market conditions and lead price forecasting cycles to enable proper budgeting and cash forecasting
  • Collaborate with the relevant R&D and technical expert teams to ensure the technical and commercial programs are fully integrated
  • Support cross functional project teams for packaging material sourcing for innovation projects (e.g. supplier sourcing input, pricing input, capacity input, etc.)
  • Provide sourcing and commercial input to Business Unit and Business Group procurement teams
  • Support packaging value improvement programs such as product logic savings projects, alternative supplier approvals, and alternate material approvals
  • Support on regulatory related topics that may impact the portfolio and business
  • Support escalations of service and quality issues (e.g. crisis management) involving stakeholders as needed

What You Need To Succeed

Experiences & Qualifications

  • University/bachelor’s degree or relevant experience
  • 2-3 years working experience in procurement or supply chain (preferably within FMCG)
  • Experience in managing supplier relationships and leading negotiations
  • Familiar with cost modeling and contracting strategies
  • Basic understanding of finance

Skills

  • Strong analytics skills including a deep knowledge of Excel
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to concisely communicate to senior level internal and external stakeholders
  • Adept at working in a global virtual network with teammates and suppliers based across the world
  • Negotiation instinct, passion for learning, ability to navigate complex situations with a hands on business mind

Leadership

  • You are energized by delivering fantastic results. You are an example to others – both your results and your resilience. You are constantly on the lookout for better ways to do things, engaging and collaborating with others along the way.
  • As an individual you are the one responsible for your own wellbeing and delivering high standards of work. You must also focus on the Consumer and what they need. You are humble and have your head up, looking around to interpret evidence and data smartly, spot issues and opportunities to make things better.
  • Critical SOL (Standards of Leadership) Behaviors
    • PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE: Takes personal responsibility and accountability for execution and results. Has an owner’s mindset, using data and insight to make decisions.
    • PERSONAL MASTERY: Sets high standards for themselves. Actively builds own wellbeing and resilience.
    • CONSUMER LOVE: Whatever their role, always looks for better ways to serve consumers. Invests time inside and outside to understand the needs of consumers.
    • PURPOSE & SERVICE: Has humility, understanding that leadership is service to others, inside and outside Unilever.
    • AGILITY: Explores the world around them, continually learning and developing their skills.
Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life! This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid work and flexibility
  • Opportunities for the development and improvement of qualifications
  • Sharing the cost of professional training & courses
  • Benefits: life insurance, private medical care, pension fund, sharing the cost of sports activities, Benefits System – Cafeteria and many others
  • Extra days off to take care of yourself and others
  • Unilever store - Our products at attractive prices

Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! At Unilever Procurement, we have big ambitions. Our Procurement with Purpose vision seeks to ensure we are a purpose-led, value-driven and future-fit organization that creates growth while delivering on Unilever’s commitments to make sustainable living commonplace.

Procurement sits at the heart of our organization. With a €33 billion spend across a diverse portfolio including food and ingredients, packaging, commodities and marketing and business services, our work touches every part of the business, putting us in a unique position to make a positive impact on people and planet.

Our 1,300+ employees operate at the forefront of competitive buying, sustainable sourcing and purpose-led partnerships. We seek to combine our own technology expertise and insights with our partners, to support the creation of disruptive sourcing strategies and supplier-led innovation that respond to ever-changing consumer needs quickly, flexibly and effectively.

We Are Looking For Procurement Professionals Who Are

  • Outstanding in idea generation, ideas that are forward thinking and that contribute to creating sustained competitive advantage.
  • Strong at selling ideas to his/her business partners, internally and externally, translating these into effective proposals conveying value and communicating it accordingly.
  • Appreciative of the value and impact of outstanding execution – an eagle eye for detail.
  • Act as an entrepreneur, treats business as his/her own, sets trends and is willing to lead, follow or get out of the way.
  • Behave as a Partner to Win ambassador and demonstrate the value Procurement adds to the business.
  • Genuinely committed to Unilever’s sustainably led business model, connected with Unilever and the business agenda.
  • Team players who lead the creation of an inclusive team environment

Purpose Of The Job

Competitive buying, sustainable sourcing and building purpose-led partnerships for Logistics services (Warehousing, Transportation) in Philippines

Key Accountabilities

You are expected to Deliver on the key matrices of World class service, Competitive Cost and Sustainable sourcing by

  • Understanding market conditions as well as forecasting future markets trends.
  • Co-creating and Implementing Procurement strategies for your portfolio.
  • Planning and Executing Procurement Decisions of who to buy from, how to buy, when to buy
  • Working closely with Internal Operations team and External Supply Partners to drive key initiatives.
  • Troubleshooting supply Chain issues (e.g. Crisis Management)
  • Identifying and Implementing tools and process to optimize sourcing practices

Qualifications

  • Either a bachelor’s degree with 5 to 7 years experience in Procurement/Supply Chain Management
  • Or a master’s degree with specialization in Procurement / Supply Chain with at least 2 years experience in Procurement / Supply Chain Management
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Financial analysis and reporting
  • Proficiency in MS Excel, Word and Power Point
  • SAP and Digital sourcing Platforms knowledge (advantage)
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Fluency in spoken and written English

About Unilever

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our, collaborative, and flexible working environment. Our organizational ambition centres around creating workplaces that foster equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging across all aspects of our business. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

About Seventh Generation

The mission of Seventh Generation is to inspire a consumer revolution that nurtures the health of the next Seventh Generations. By establishing a talent powerhouse that brings our principles, practices, and partnerships to life we will build the most trusted brand in the industry.

Five Strong Values Are At The Heart Of SVG

Care Wholeheartedly. We have big hearts: they are full of our love for the planet, our consumers, our people, our partners, our products, and our brand.

Collaborate Deliberately. It takes a village right? Together we can achieve things that we could never have done by ourselves. Not to mention it’s a lot less lonely.

Nurture Nature. Nature got it right. We know it. That’s why we aspire to design products from plants not petroleum, from fields not factories.

Innovate Disruptively. If you always do what you have done you will always get what you always got. We think innovation and creativity can change the world.

Be a Trusted Brand. Can a company be a friend? We like to think so. We love our consumers and we hope they love and trust us.

Job Purpose

Unilever is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world.

What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be

dComm Content Readiness

Maintain digital commerce (dComm) content readiness in Unilever’s systems, including TAB and KWERY, ensuring best-in-class content syndication across our retail footprint

Establish targets, investigate & launch automation opportunities via AI, and build processes to ensure 100% content readiness

Build strong relationships with UL system experts, SVG’s Demand Generation team, the dHub, and retail teams to ensure up-to-date content standards

Vendor Management

Own the relationship with our portfolio of technology providers, including integration, day-to-day maintenance and development worksteams to ensure the Marketing teams have the tools necessary to deliver on their goals

Orchestrate contract (re)negotiations & constant re-evaluation of capabilities and roadmaps to keep SVG ahead of the curve

Own the budget & billing process for all MarTech vendors, including inputs to monthly financial cycle

Website Ownership

Own SVG.com as a marketing engine, including a streamlined and simplified UX that delivers on our total marketing team’s needs

Partner with the dHub Lead and the Marketing Leadership Team to establish a vision for a simplified SVG.com, including establishing key performance benchmarks

Identify opportunities and headwinds to achieve our business outcomes, and build project plans to address each by partnering with vendors and internal SVG stakeholders

Constantly evaluate new ways to streamline and automate, including leveraging Unilever’s global resources

Measurement & Reporting

Establish analytics and performance tracking strategy for marketing technologies within the tech stack. Establish KPIs, track & report on channel effectiveness

Manage, integrate, and align information from multiple sources and consistently report out with learnings and actionable insights to stakeholders

Drive a culture of data-driven decision making by providing actionable, business-based insights sourced from our real-time user behavior (web site, CRM, email, etc.) that encourage a test-learn-evolve practice in our marketing

Experiences & Qualifications

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED

Bachelor’s degree (minimum) in Marketing or equivalent related field experience required.

4+ years relevant technology experience in a Brand Marketing environment, including experience managing execution and development teams

Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) experience a plus

Experience managing the systems that make up the marketing technology stack, including but not limited to Customer Relationship Marketing (CRM, Email Service Platforms (ESP), Content Management Systems (CMS), website & eComm platforms, Google Analytics & Tag Manager, etc.

Possess a thorough understanding of marketing automation, consumer data management, digital asset management, marketing analytics, and digital advertising/promotional technologies (including CRM, email services, loyalty platforms, content management, etc)

Excellent verbal and written interpersonal and communication skills, whether working with creative, executive, or data-driven teams.

A strong collaborator who seeks out cross-functional feedback and input to build comprehensive recommendations and drive well-informed strategies.

Self-starter who enjoys technical challenges and embraces new opportunities.

Able to stay flexible and agile in fast-paced work environment

Skills

Relationship Management & Negotiation

Digital & Performance Marketing

Communications Asset Development

Commercial Acumen

job_title: Global Business Analytics and Social Intelligence Analyst, Home & Hygiene
job_summary: Job Title: Business & Social Intelligence Analyst – Home Care (Global) Business Function: Consumer Insight (CI) Location: London (100VE) Job Purpose Make Data Matter. Be a Future Shaper. At Unilever Home Care, we’re committed to creating products that make everyday life better and brighter for our homes, for people, and for the planet. We’re looking for a curious, data-driven analysts to join our Business Analytics & Social Intelligence (BASI) team. This role partners with category teams (e.g. Fabric Cleaning, Fabric Enhancers, Home & Hygiene) to shape strategy, identify growth opportunities and enhance competitive performance across the Home Care Business Group - with a strong emphasis on understanding consumers through social listening and digital intelligence tools. You’ll be part of a diverse, multicultural team that blends business analytics, strategic research, and social intelligence - working closely with global and local teams across Marketing, CD, R&D, Finance, and external partners / leading agencies to deliver insight and recommendations that drive action. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll help shape the future of Home Care through foresight, smart data, world-class analytics, and AI-powered solutions. Responsibilities Turn data into direction Extract and deliver clear, actionable insights using retail, panel, financial, brand tracking, and social data to guide strategy and performance. Keep us on track Own key reporting dashboards and performance metrics - from UBS, price tiering, to product benefit segmentation - and help teams stay aligned on what matters. Project what’s next Support long-term planning by helping forecast category trends and format shifts, working with cross-functional teams and world-class analytics partners. Power big ideas Lead the analytics behind market development, innovation sizing, benchmarking, and strategic bets - making sure we back the right ideas with the right data. Make operations smooth Help manage priorities and day-to-day operations for our analytics workstreams, keeping things running smart and efficiently. Who You’ll Work With You’ll report to the Global Business Analytics and Social Intelligence Director and collaborate closely with category marketing, finance, R&D, CD, CI teams, and external partners. All About You You’re naturally curious, comfortable with data, and excited by the idea of turning complex information into clear direction. You might come from a background in continuous research (retail tracking, consumer panels, brand tracking) or social and advanced analytics and data science (either way, you know how to make data work). Here’s What Helps You Thrive In This Role You get data. You know how to spot what matters in a sea of numbers, build smart data strategies, and visualise insights that make sense to others. You’re analytical and creative. Whether it’s crunching numbers or designing new ways to interpret them, you bring rigour and imagination to your work. You think in systems. You understand how businesses grow and how different teams connect - and you use that knowledge to drive impact. You zoom out and zoom in. You can think big across market, categories and brands, but also dive deep into the details when needed. You tell stories with foresight. You know how to turn data into compelling narratives that spark action and show the business how to grow in the future. You’re curious about people and tech. You’re interested in human behaviour, innovation, and how technology can unlock better decisions. You’re digitally fluent. You’re comfortable with new tools and platforms, and keen to help others adopt smarter, self-service systems. What We’re Looking For Experience in both business analytics and social intelligence. Ideally university degree or equivalent experience. We could also explore top-performing candidates from Unilever’s apprenticeship programmes as part of the selection process. Eligibility to work in the UK is required. Bonus points if you’ve got a foundation in data science or modelling - not essential, but great to have. NOTES About Unilever Unilever is one of the world’s leading suppliers of Food, Home and Personal Care products with sales in over 190 countries and reaching 2 billion consumers a day. Unilever has more than 400 brands found in homes around the world, including Dove, Tresemme, Lynx, Lifebuoy, Shea Moisture, Persil, Domestos, Ben & Jerry’s, Magnum, Marmite, The Vegetarian Butcher, Graze and Pot Noodle. Faced with the challenge of climate change and the need for human development, we want to move towards a world where everyone can live well and within the natural limits of the planet. That’s why our purpose is ‘to make sustainable living commonplace’ Location In June 2020 we announced our plan to consolidate a number of Unilever’s offices across the South East of England into a new Unilever campus in Kingston-upon-Thames in or around early 2025. However, on the 08 August 2024 we announced to our existing staff our proposal to retain our central Head Office in London, 100 Victoria Embankment (“100VE”) until our lease expires in 2027. As a result of this new proposal, we will be consulting with our existing staff, and new joiners who join during this period of consultation at 100VE, on the proposal made in August 2024. During consultation we will clarify the future location of each team and function. This means your role will either be based in 100VE until 2027 or in Kingston-Upon-Thames from early 2025. As we are yet to commence consultation on the proposal you agree, until such a time when consultation has concluded, your normal place of work as set out in the enclosed Statement of Terms & Conditions will be 100VE. You agree that on the conclusion of the consultation your place of work will be 100VE or 100VE until early 2025 and then Kingston-upon-Thames ("the locations") and you will be notified of which of the locations will be your place of work after that consultation ends. Job Title: Business & Social Intelligence Analyst – Home Care (Global)

Business Function: Consumer Insight (CI)

Location: London (100VE)

Job Purpose

Make Data Matter. Be a Future Shaper.

At Unilever Home Care, we’re committed to creating products that make everyday life better and brighter for our homes, for people, and for the planet.

We’re looking for a curious, data-driven analysts to join our Business Analytics & Social Intelligence (BASI) team. This role partners with category teams (e.g. Fabric Cleaning, Fabric Enhancers, Home & Hygiene) to shape strategy, identify growth opportunities and enhance competitive performance across the Home Care Business Group - with a strong emphasis on understanding consumers through social listening and digital intelligence tools.

You’ll be part of a diverse, multicultural team that blends business analytics, strategic research, and social intelligence - working closely with global and local teams across Marketing, CD, R&D, Finance, and external partners / leading agencies to deliver insight and recommendations that drive action. This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll help shape the future of Home Care through foresight, smart data, world-class analytics, and AI-powered solutions.

Responsibilities

Turn data into direction

Extract and deliver clear, actionable insights using retail, panel, financial, brand tracking, and social data to guide strategy and performance.

  • Keep us on track

Own key reporting dashboards and performance metrics - from UBS, price tiering, to product benefit segmentation - and help teams stay aligned on what matters.

  • Project what’s next

Support long-term planning by helping forecast category trends and format shifts, working with cross-functional teams and world-class analytics partners.

  • Power big ideas

Lead the analytics behind market development, innovation sizing, benchmarking, and strategic bets - making sure we back the right ideas with the right data.

  • Make operations smooth

Help manage priorities and day-to-day operations for our analytics workstreams, keeping things running smart and efficiently.

Who You’ll Work With

You’ll report to the Global Business Analytics and Social Intelligence Director and collaborate closely with category marketing, finance, R&D, CD, CI teams, and external partners.

All About You

You’re naturally curious, comfortable with data, and excited by the idea of turning complex information into clear direction. You might come from a background in continuous research (retail tracking, consumer panels, brand tracking) or social and advanced analytics and data science (either way, you know how to make data work).

Here’s What Helps You Thrive In This Role

  • You get data. You know how to spot what matters in a sea of numbers, build smart data strategies, and visualise insights that make sense to others.
  • You’re analytical and creative. Whether it’s crunching numbers or designing new ways to interpret them, you bring rigour and imagination to your work.
  • You think in systems. You understand how businesses grow and how different teams connect - and you use that knowledge to drive impact.
  • You zoom out and zoom in. You can think big across market, categories and brands, but also dive deep into the details when needed.
  • You tell stories with foresight. You know how to turn data into compelling narratives that spark action and show the business how to grow in the future.
  • You’re curious about people and tech. You’re interested in human behaviour, innovation, and how technology can unlock better decisions.
  • You’re digitally fluent. You’re comfortable with new tools and platforms, and keen to help others adopt smarter, self-service systems.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in both business analytics and social intelligence.
  • Ideally university degree or equivalent experience.
  • We could also explore top-performing candidates from Unilever’s apprenticeship programmes as part of the selection process.
  • Eligibility to work in the UK is required.
  • Bonus points if you’ve got a foundation in data science or modelling - not essential, but great to have.

NOTES

About Unilever

Unilever is one of the world’s leading suppliers of Food, Home and Personal Care products with sales in over 190 countries and reaching 2 billion consumers a day. Unilever has more than 400 brands found in homes around the world, including Dove, Tresemme, Lynx, Lifebuoy, Shea Moisture, Persil, Domestos, Ben & Jerry’s, Magnum, Marmite, The Vegetarian Butcher, Graze and Pot Noodle.

Faced with the challenge of climate change and the need for human development, we want to move towards a world where everyone can live well and within the natural limits of the planet. That’s why our purpose is ‘to make sustainable living commonplace’

Location 

In June 2020 we announced our plan to consolidate a number of Unilever’s offices across the South East of England into a new Unilever campus in Kingston-upon-Thames in or around early 2025. However, on the 08 August 2024 we announced to our existing staff our proposal to retain our central Head Office in London, 100 Victoria Embankment (“100VE”) until our lease expires in 2027. As a result of this new proposal, we will be consulting with our existing staff, and new joiners who join during this period of consultation at 100VE, on the proposal made in August 2024. During consultation we will clarify the future location of each team and function. This means your role will either be based in 100VE until 2027 or in Kingston-Upon-Thames from early 2025. As we are yet to commence consultation on the proposal you agree, until such a time when consultation has concluded, your normal place of work as set out in the enclosed Statement of Terms & Conditions will be 100VE. You agree that on the conclusion of the consultation your place of work will be 100VE or 100VE until early 2025 and then Kingston-upon-Thames ("the locations") and you will be notified of which of the locations will be your place of work after that consultation ends.

What We Offer

Not only do we offer a competitive salary and pension scheme, we also offer an annual bonus, subsidised gym membership, a discounted staff shop and shares. You’ll have the opportunity to work directly with our renowned and exciting brands in a flexible and hybrid working environment.

Whilst the role is advertised on a full-time basis, we would be happy to discuss possible flexible working options and what this may look like for you. We are a key advocate of wellbeing and offer a variety of support for our people including hubs, programmes and development opportunities. We strive to achieve a family-friendly and inclusive workplace and to, above all, create possibilities for all.

Diversity at Unilever is about inclusion, embracing differences, creating possibilities and growing together for better business performance. We embrace diversity in our workforce. This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity. We are also more than happy to provide reasonable adjustments during our application and interview process to enable you to be present your best self. To find out more, including about our Employee Resource Groups, please click here Equity, Diversity & Inclusion at Unilever | Unilever.

Recruitment Fraud

Cyber criminals advertise fake job adverts with prestigious employers as a way of stealing information or even defrauding individuals out of money. In the most sophisticated cases, they will set up fake websites, which have a similar address to companies like Unilever. They even conduct fake telephone interviews and then offer candidates a role with the proviso they pay a fee for background checks or to cover work visa costs.  These types of attacks are becoming more common as more people are looking for employment in the economic climate.

How is Unilever tackling this?

Many of Unilever’s recruitment sites publish a warning to candidates about recruitment fraud. The Cyber Security team also proactively scan for signs of people setting up fake Unilever sites and act to close them down.

What can I do?

If you become aware of potential recruitment fraud, spot fake Unilever recruitment adverts or fake LinkedIn profiles, report them via Una Live Chat.

Unilever does not accept responsibility or liability for any candidates who are financially impacted by recruitment fraud. Your vigilance is key!

Main Job Purpose


Site Quality Lead is to assist with the quality assurance processes to the business in order to ensure that products produced by the company are fit for use by the consumers according to Company’s specifications, regulatory standard and ISO standard.


Quality in Enterprise

  • Raises awareness of business implications of both increasing satisfaction and reducing dissatisfaction of customer / consumer among cross functional team.


Quality Planning

  • Develops and maintains the Company Quality Assurance and Control.
  • Support validation of Company and regulatory Quality requirements when products or processes change.
  • Develops specific training materials & events and conducts training (as needed)
  • Ensures Quality team has a level of required skills and knowledge as appropriate to support site quality programs.
  • Identifies where learning opportunities can be used to close skill gaps or raise level of skills and knowledge.


Quality in Operations

  • Prepares and updates work instructions, Quality and HACCP Plans based on Factory Quality Management System and Establish of the Quality System for assigned factories.
  • Lead in the conduct of factory training of these procedures to ensure that these are understood, implemented, and aligned current Unilever standard.
  • Lead Factory Mock Recall activity and improve the traceability practice of the factory.
  • Provides technical support in the conduct of product quality investigation.
  • Drives factory Quality Operational Reviews and supports implementation of corrective actions to meet recommendations.
  • Puts in place, validates, and verifies prerequisite programs for risk mitigation (e.g cleaning, pest control, housekeeping, etc.)
  • Supports development protocols, methods, equipment & limits used for maintenance, inspection, sampling, testing or monitoring (in line, on line and off line) for manufacturing processes and products.
  • Assesses and approve equipment and process changes in factory for adverse effects on product quality.
  • Lead QC team from assigned factories to set up QC procedures in the factories.


Quality Improvement

  • Defines relevant KPIs, builds scorecards & reports for Quality KPIs and other metrics
  • Monitors and reports Quality KPIs and provides data aggregation and analysis as needed at the appropriate level.
  • Uses data analysis and IT tools, relevant statistical techniques to identify trends and understand (Quality) performance movement and highlight areas for improvement.
  • Leads improvements in Innovation processes in order to reduce Quality losses and improve speed to market.

  • University degree in Science or Engineering or equivalent industrial experience. Preferred Zoology, Biochemistry, Chemistry, Industrial Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Food Science or Microbiology degree.
  • 3 - 5 years’ experience in Quality, Manufacturing or R&D. 3 years of Manufacturing Site Experience and Safety Experience.
  • Excellent knowledge and experiences in Supply Chain Operations of Manufacturing Industry and Engineering Experience.
  • Understanding of Quality Management System (ISO 9001) and knowledge of HACCP, GMP.
  • Influencing skills. Good observation and auditing skills.
  • Proven track record of analytical thinking and project management.

  • Good in Excel, Power Point, Word

  • Comfortable with number and data learning and management
  • Learning agility and adaptability in a demanding and fast-paced environment

  • 3–5+ years of experience in IT service delivery, digital transformation, or system implementation roles.

job_summary: Piensa como un emprendedor, acelera tu crecimiento, sé vanguardista y disfruta del éxito. ¡Únete a nosotros! Unilever Food Solutions es una Unidad de Negocio Global independiente, la 5ta más grande de Unilever. Representa el 20% del Business Group de Nutrition y opera en 76 mercados con una facturación de alrededor de €3 mil millones. Nuestra ambición es clara: Alcanzar los €5 mil millones en 2030, convertirnos en líderes de ventas digitales en la industria de food service, ser el mejor proveedor de soluciones para nuestros operadores y el planeta, construir un motor de personas ganadoras. UFS opera con un modelo de negocio distinto con un fuerte enfoque en chefs y ventas de campo para impulsar la creación de demanda con operadores en un entorno B2B. UFS es un negocio único dentro de Unilever, con un constante enfoque en la excelencia operacional y la mejora continua de la productividad, lo que nos permite generar un valor significativo gracias al experiencia profesional que tenemos en el canal de foodservice que cuenta con una unidad de negocio dedicada a la industria alimentaria. Unilever Food Solutions en America Latina es un negocio de $300mn. ¡UFS es el lugar donde serás un Chef apoyando a Chefs! En UFS contamos con una cultura emprendedora, comprometida con la velocidad, la simplicidad y la confianza, y con un fuerte deseo de crecimiento, tanto del negocio como de las personas. UFS también se enorgullece de su alto compromiso de los empleados, con puntajes de Univoice por encima del promedio de Unilever en todas las dimensiones. Es el lugar donde puedes tomar riesgos, experimentar e iterar, ser un pionero. Puedes pensar y trabajar como dueño de tu propio negocio y estar a la vanguardia. Con el propósito de "Liberarte para amar lo que haces" y el ADN de "empatía con las personas a las que servimos y la experiencia para satisfacer sus necesidades 24/7", serás parte de una organización centrada en las personas. CUALES SERÁN TU PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES Asegurar el cumplimiento de los planes de venta, turnover / mixes / estrategias cluster/categoría/geografías. Asegurar el cumplimiento de los planes de crecimiento de demanda, co liderando el crecimiento en cantidad de operadores en cada cliente / y otras métricas como Grab y Penetration Liderar la fuerza de ventas de comercio mediante la estrategia de ventas identificada, el trabajo a realizar, los recursos y los habilitadores clave necesarios para maximizar las oportunidades de negocio y de mercado. Gestionar y controlar la fuerza de ventas para desarrollar sus habilidades a través del coaching en el campo, la formación en el trabajo para asegurar que se logre un alto estándar profesional y que se cumplan los objetivos de ventas mensuales y anuales; Coordinar con Trade Marketing para explotar los mercados asignados y las oportunidades de negocio; Desarrollar un plan de promoción integrado óptimo (incluyendo la venta del plan al cliente) y gestionar las inversiones promocionales en línea con las prioridades de UFS y con la alineación de las funciones de marketing comercial y finanzas; Gestionar el Turn Over de clientes (USG) y el acuerdo de rentabilidad; Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con otras funciones: Trade Marketing, Finanzas, Chef, Generación de Demanda, SC, Marketing, para asegurar que todas las operaciones se desarrollen sin problemas. Habilidad analítica numérica, capacidad de diagnosticar y priorizar presupuestos y objetivos. Capacidad de planificación y asignación de presupuestos, y elección via ROI de las mejores alternativas para lograr los objetivos de corto-mediano-largo. Capacidad de revisión de ruta al mercado. Digital experience / knowledge prefered (al menos “promotor digital” o que co-construya el liderazgo del crecimiento de canales digitales de venta. Orientación al trabajo en equipos multifuncionales con objetivos contrapuestos y complementarios. Conocimiento y comprensión de canales de ventas tradicionales, canales mayoristas, canales modernos y la industria de servicios de alimentos. Buenas habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar en coordinación con personas. Buenas habilidades analíticas, de negociación y sólidas habilidades de liderazgo. Disfrutar trabajar en un entorno dinámico y exigente. Habilidades de automotivación, enfoque en resultados y motivación del equipo. Mente aguda y siempre generar nuevas ideas. Siempre estar dispuesto a nuevos desafíos Buen dominio del inglés. En Unilever, Queremos Generar Experiencias Que Transformen a Las Personas. Unilever is currently hiring for BU Lead – UI Indonesia based in Jakarta, Indonesia

About Unilever

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

Unilever International is…

We treat the business as our own.

As intrapreneurs, we introduce Unilever’s brands into white space geographies like Korea, Pacific Islands, Mongolia, and spearhead launches of iconic household brands like Dove, Lifebuoy, Sunlight, Fair & Lovely, TRESemme into big markets like U.S, China, Western Europe and SEAA.

As Unilever’s growth engine, we establish global white space businesses in key channels such as Health & Beauty, Discounters, E-Commerce and alternate channels such as travel retail, marketing to institutional partners like the United Nations, and seeding Unilever brands to overseas diaspora who crave for a taste of their familiar home brands.

We are 1bn+ , fast growing, hyper agile. Our role is to challenge the status quo, identify new opportunities to grow, deeply collaborate with the BG/BU and serve underserved consumers, channels, customers, geographies and categories.

Our next mission is to go from 1bn+ to 5bn and become a role model CPG organisation in 3 key areas – purposeful marketing, digitization and making UI the best place to work.

Singapore is our global hub leading strategy, marketing thinking, seeding plans, and alignment with the global categories and supply chain.

Game changing business

SPEED is the mantra for our resounding success. To serve the underserved, we embrace a founder’s mentality, explore unchartered territories, redesign end-to-end business models to establish successful businesses. We make a difference through 5 traits of – 1. hunger for growth 2. Working and winning together 3. Passion for execution 4. Consumer and Customer obsession 5. Nurturing our tribe.

We will be the fastest route-to-market globally;

We go where no (man, woman or distributor) has ever explored; Impossible is an opinion, not a fact; Speed is our currency; When brands are built right, they can last a lifetime.

Job Purpose

Unilever is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. If you want to lead the UI Indonesia Seeding Team across marketing, KAM, BDM and Operations, managing various business initiatives, then this role is just for you!

Main Responsibilities

Marketing & Strategy:

  • You will lead the UI Indonesia Seeding Team across marketing, KAM, BDM and Operations, the incumbent will execute end to end management of various business initiatives in country
  • UI’s future growth will come from brand building at scale in the market by being the best in class in global digital marketing across search, social, performance marketing and moving to the final ultimate phase of direct to consumer and first party data
  • You will working with the marketing team, digital marketing excellence, marketing culture and organisation, a culture of consumer and customer obsession and work to be a pioneer in the world of digital marketing
  • You will engage and interact with the Indonesia CD and marketing community across all BG to drive full alignment and engagement and craft UI’s role in the new unilever BG/BU world
  • The No.1 Responsibility for the BU Indonesia UI Seeding Lead is to scale brands in market to become segment and channel leaders globally in key markets

Local Consolidation Export

  • You’ll drive end-to-end management of Local Consolidation Export initiatives and manage existing business within Indonesia
  • You’ll coordinate across multi-functional teams to bring projects to life and drive business growth.
  • Ensure strict compliance to governance and mandate whilst leading, mapping and developing business opportunity for export.

Distributor Management

  • You’ll lead the BD and KA teams to analyse the market and lead cross-functional UI teams to land innovations in market fast with impact.
  • You’ll drive end-to-end management of seeding initiatives and manage existing business within Indonesia and coordinate across multi-functional teams to bring projects to life and drive business growth.

Retailer Management

  • Works closely with customers to implement the business plan. Works in close collaboration with the Category Team for the category input, and with customer marketing & brand teams for the specific banner/channel plan
  • Develop and then implements the optimal integrated promo plan (incl. selling the plan to the customer) and manage promo investments.
  • Manages customer promo investment with the customer ensuring all MAP accruals input are completed in a timely manner.
  • Provide clear objectives and deliverables for the Operational team (CDE’s Operations & field team)

Candidate Criteria

Experience & Qualification

  • Over 10 years’ experience in FMCG industry in building brands globally, driving digital marketing, Customer Development and Trade Marketing

Skill

  • Be a strategic, highly adaptable and entrepreneurial person
  • Embrace a high growth mindset, with strong love for consumers, shoppers and customers
  • Have excellent financial acumen and analytical skills
  • Have excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills with senior stakeholders
  • Have experience working and leading in cross-functional teams

Leadership

  • You are energized by delivering fantastic results. You are an example to others – both your results and your resilience. You are constantly on the lookout for better ways to do things, engaging and collaborating with others along the way.
  • As an individual you are the one responsible for your own wellbeing and delivering high standards of work. You must also focus on the Consumer and what they need. You are humble and have your head up, looking around to interpret evidence and data smartly, spot issues and opportunities to make things better.

ONLY FOR WL2+:

  • You are an inclusive motivator of people. Your team delivers with real passion, growing and learning from each other whilst delivering quick wins.
  • You are still responsible for your own results and as a team leader, you also need to motivate others to deliver with passion, creating an inclusive and engaging climate around you. You can balance challenge with support and coaching. You understand the wider business context and you are emotionally intelligent enough to motivate people to deliver what is needed.
  • Critical SOL (Standards of Leadership) Behaviors
    • PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE: Sets high standards for themselves. Has emotional intelligence to take feedback, manage mood and motivations, and build empathy for others.
    • PERSONAL MASTERY: Generates intensity and focus to motivate people to deliver results at speed. Takes personal responsibility and accountability for own wellbeing and resilience.
    • CONSUMER LOVE: Invests time inside and outside to understand the needs of consumers.
    • PURPOSE & SERVICE: Has humility, understanding that leadership is service to others, inside and outside Unilever.
    • BUSINESS ACUMEN: Creates sustainable growth with purpose, engaging different partners across the system for change.
    • TALENT CATALYST: Invests in people – coaches individuals and teams to realize their full potential. Creates an inclusive climate, empowering everyone to be at their best. Inspires powerful teamwork and collaboration, connecting people for better results.

    • Provide visibility of cost types by geography / division
    • Ensure cross charges are aligned with respective entities and executed OTIF

  • Business Excellence Lead – drive continuous process improvement in the Process Excellence Leadership Team (PELT) forum. Also ensure proper training and documentation in place (License to Operate) for all processes for ease of knowledge transfer.

  • Controls: Ensure financial records are in compliance with accepted policies, procedures and external/SOX controls requirements. Ensure robustness of internal controls including clear segregation of duties, disciplined implementation of schedule of authority, robust payment approval/verification process, credit assessment, budgetary system adherence.
  • Manage month end activities: Monthly forecasting, Month end review, Analysis, Drive Insights and Actions with focus on: Overheads initiatives as part of the Fuel for Growth Agenda and Efficiency of investments (ROMI)
  • Develop close working relationships with the Global UI Finance team and share best practices across the broader UI finance team.
  • Digital Analytics : Any other Digital & capability improvements though new process/system implementation of UI finance vision and priorities
  • The roles of duties are not exhaustive and may change according to business requirements.

  • UI Leadership team and other functional teams
  • HR team
  • UniOps and 3P service provider teams based in India and Philippines.

  • 5-7 years of progressive experience in various Finance roles.
  • In depth knowledge of Operational / Financial Processes: Performance Management
  • Experience in one of the Business partnering roles: Supply Chain, Sales, Marketing
  • Commercial support and decision support (including preparing financial models and ROI analysis)
  • Strong Analytical capabilities with bias to Drive Action.
  • Ability to handle large complex data set
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills, SAP and BW operational Knowledge

Soft Skills

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Mature and highly credible individual with strong business and financial acumen.
  • Flexibility and comfortable working in a fast pace matrix reporting environment.
  • Ability to operate independently and in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to earn respect and trust from senior management.
  • Self-driven, forward looking, results-oriented with a positive outlook and a clear focus
  • Diligent and willing to be hands, ‘roll up your sleeves’.
