The Magnum Ice Cream Company is all about growth. Growing our business. Growing our customers’ businesses. Growing our people’s careers. Growth begins with empowerment. So we free our people to be innovative, responsible entrepreneurs, driven and equipped to give our consumers more amazing products and unforgettable moments – and having fun doing it.

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry. We have been taking pleasure seriously for more than 100 years, serving happiness with every lick or scoop of ice cream for generations.

We are investing to unlock the full growth potential of The Magnum Ice Cream Company as a standalone entity, once we separate from Unilever, which is planned to happen before the end of 2025.

We dream big but keep things simple to act fast.

If you want to grow with us, make an impact, and shape the future of Ice Cream, this is the place for you!

Job Purpose

Ice Cream SHE Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing comprehensive safety, health, and environmental programs to ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and company standards. This includes conducting regular risk assessments, safety audits, and inspections to identify and mitigate potential hazards. The manager will also lead incident investigations, analyze root causes, and implement corrective actions to prevent future occurrences.

In addition, the IC SHE Manager plays a crucial role in driving continuous improvement initiatives and aligning SHE strategies with organizational goals. By collaborating with cross-functional teams, the manager ensures that safety and environmental standards are integrated into all operational processes. The role also involves mentoring and coaching team members, developing their skills, and empowering them to take ownership of SHE responsibilities, thereby creating a sustainable and safety-conscious work environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure Regulatory Compliance: Monitor and ensure compliance with local, national, and corporate SHE regulations and standards and maintain up-to-date knowledge of SHE laws and regulations relevant to the site.
  • Develop and Implement SHE Programs: Design and implement site-specific SHE policies, procedures, and training programs, promote a strong safety culture across all levels of the organization.
  • Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Conduct regular risk assessments and implement preventive and corrective actions to mitigate SHE risks.
  • Process Safety Management (PSM): Oversee implementation of process safety elements such as MOC (Management of Change), PSSR (Pre-Startup Safety Review), and hazard studies (HAZOP, LOPA) and ensure integrity of critical safety systems and compliance with process safety standards.
  • Incident Management: Lead investigations of incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions. Ensure root cause analysis and timely implementation of corrective actions.
  • Training and Awareness: Conduct SHE training for employees, contractors, and visitors. Facilitate safety campaigns, toolbox talks, and behavioural safety programs.
  • Emergency Preparedness: Develop and test emergency response plans (e.g., fire, chemical release, natural disaster). Coordinate with local emergency services and internal response teams.
  • SHE Performance Monitoring: Track and report SHE KPIs and u se data analytics to drive continuous improvement.
  • Audit and Inspection: Conduct internal SHE audits and support external audits. Ensure timely closure of audit findings and non-conformities.
  • Environmental Management: Oversee waste management (including WWTP operation) , emissions control, and sustainability initiatives. Ensure compliance with environmental permits and reporting obligations.
  • Site Security Management: Collaborate with security teams to ensure physical security of the site. Support implementation of access control, surveillance, and emergency lockdown procedures.
  • Stakeholder Engagement Liaise with site leadership, HR, operations, and external stakeholders on SHE and security matters. Represent the site in corporate SHE and security forums.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering/environmental science/ safety management, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in safety, health, and environmental management, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial setting.
  • Proven leadership experience with a track record of developing and managing teams.
  • Certification in safety management is a plus.

What You Need To Succeed

  • Strong leadership and team development abilities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in conducting risk assessments, safety audits, and incident investigations.
  • In-depth knowledge of SHE regulations and best practices.
  • Ability to develop and implement effective training programs.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong skills in understanding data and sharing insights through clear communication

LEADERSHIP: The Ice Cream Way

We Are Looking For Bold, Driven Individuals Who Thrive In a Fast-paced, Dynamic Environment And Share Our Approach To Growth, Collaboration, And Innovation. Here’s What Defines Success In Our Organization

Focus on Growth – Embracing new challenges, seeking opportunities to innovate, and continuously looking for ways to expand and improve. Whether it’s scaling markets, evolving roles, or leading teams, we value those who see possibilities and take initiative.

Speed & Simplicity – Working efficiently, adapting quickly, and simplifying processes by leveraging technology to drive better outcomes. With ethical decision-making as the backbone to this, we drive agility and stay focused.

Winning with Fun – Collaborating, integrating seamlessly with a founder/owner mindset, keeping what’s best for the company at the heart of all that is done. We build diverse, inclusive, and winning teams that drive our business.

Bold Innovations – Experimenting with fresh ideas and innovative thinking that shape our industry, through product development, process improvements, and customer experiences. Being obsessed with the consumer, we embrace change to drive growth.

Care & Challenge – Fostering an open, transparent environment where team members can grow, share feedback openly, holding themselves and each other to high standards while maintaining a strong sense of support and camaraderie.

Expertise in our category – A deep understanding of our industry, customers, and market trends enabling us to stay ahead and turn challenges into opportunities. Curiosity, insight, and a willingness to learn and lead enables us to remain market makers.

If these qualities resonate with you, we’d love to connect and explore how you can be part of our team.

Additional Information

As publicly announced, it is envisaged that Unilever will internally separate its Ice Cream business by July 2025, at which point this role will transfer to the new Ice Cream company. It is expected that the Ice Cream business will then separate from Unilever by the end of 2025. Any impact on terms and conditions of employment will be communicated in due course. Please also attach your letter of redundancy to the application.

Your application will be reviewed against our requirements, and we will be in touch shortly after the closing date to provide you with an update on the status of your application.

The Ice Cream division at Unilever is preparing to stand on its own, aiming to become an independent, EUR 8.3 billion publicly listed company by the end of 2025. We’re on a mission to create the ultimate snacking company. A place where growth, innovation, founder and ownership mentality, and performance are cultivated and rewarded. And where we craft extraordinary ice cream experiences - transforming ordinary moments into lasting memories. Because we know, life tastes better with ice cream.

About The Magnum Ice Cream Company

The Magnum Ice Cream Company is all about growth. Growing our business. Growing our customers’ businesses. Growing our people’s careers. Growth begins with empowerment. So we free our people to be innovative, responsible entrepreneurs, driven and equipped to give our consumers more amazing products and unforgettable moments – and having fun doing it.

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry. We have been taking pleasure seriously for more than 100 years, serving happiness with every lick or scoop of ice cream for generations.

We are investing to unlock the full growth potential of The Magnum Ice Cream Company as a standalone entity, once we separate from Unilever, which is planned to happen before the end of 2025.

We dream big but keep things simple to act fast.

If you want to grow with us, make an impact, and shape the future of Ice Cream, this is the place for you!

Job Purpose

Ice Cream SHE Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing comprehensive safety, health, and environmental programs to ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements and company standards. This includes conducting regular risk assessments, safety audits, and inspections to identify and mitigate potential hazards. The manager will also lead incident investigations, analyze root causes, and implement corrective actions to prevent future occurrences.

In addition, the IC SHE Manager plays a crucial role in driving continuous improvement initiatives and aligning SHE strategies with organizational goals. By collaborating with cross-functional teams, the manager ensures that safety and environmental standards are integrated into all operational processes. The role also involves mentoring and coaching team members, developing their skills, and empowering them to take ownership of SHE responsibilities, thereby creating a sustainable and safety-conscious work environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure Regulatory Compliance: Monitor and ensure compliance with local, national, and corporate SHE regulations and standards and maintain up-to-date knowledge of SHE laws and regulations relevant to the site.
  • Develop and Implement SHE Programs: Design and implement site-specific SHE policies, procedures, and training programs, promote a strong safety culture across all levels of the organization.
  • Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Conduct regular risk assessments and implement preventive and corrective actions to mitigate SHE risks.
  • Process Safety Management (PSM): Oversee implementation of process safety elements such as MOC (Management of Change), PSSR (Pre-Startup Safety Review), and hazard studies (HAZOP, LOPA) and ensure integrity of critical safety systems and compliance with process safety standards.
  • Incident Management: Lead investigations of incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions. Ensure root cause analysis and timely implementation of corrective actions.
  • Training and Awareness: Conduct SHE training for employees, contractors, and visitors. Facilitate safety campaigns, toolbox talks, and behavioural safety programs.
  • Emergency Preparedness: Develop and test emergency response plans (e.g., fire, chemical release, natural disaster). Coordinate with local emergency services and internal response teams.
  • SHE Performance Monitoring: Track and report SHE KPIs and u se data analytics to drive continuous improvement.
  • Audit and Inspection: Conduct internal SHE audits and support external audits. Ensure timely closure of audit findings and non-conformities.
  • Environmental Management: Oversee waste management (including WWTP operation) , emissions control, and sustainability initiatives. Ensure compliance with environmental permits and reporting obligations.
  • Site Security Management: Collaborate with security teams to ensure physical security of the site. Support implementation of access control, surveillance, and emergency lockdown procedures.
  • Stakeholder Engagement Liaise with site leadership, HR, operations, and external stakeholders on SHE and security matters. Represent the site in corporate SHE and security forums.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering/environmental science/ safety management, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in safety, health, and environmental management, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial setting.
  • Proven leadership experience with a track record of developing and managing teams.
  • Certification in safety management is a plus.

What You Need To Succeed

  • Strong leadership and team development abilities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in conducting risk assessments, safety audits, and incident investigations.
  • In-depth knowledge of SHE regulations and best practices.
  • Ability to develop and implement effective training programs.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong skills in understanding data and sharing insights through clear communication

LEADERSHIP: The Ice Cream Way

We Are Looking For Bold, Driven Individuals Who Thrive In a Fast-paced, Dynamic Environment And Share Our Approach To Growth, Collaboration, And Innovation. Here’s What Defines Success In Our Organization

Focus on Growth – Embracing new challenges, seeking opportunities to innovate, and continuously looking for ways to expand and improve. Whether it’s scaling markets, evolving roles, or leading teams, we value those who see possibilities and take initiative.

Speed & Simplicity – Working efficiently, adapting quickly, and simplifying processes by leveraging technology to drive better outcomes. With ethical decision-making as the backbone to this, we drive agility and stay focused.

Winning with Fun – Collaborating, integrating seamlessly with a founder/owner mindset, keeping what’s best for the company at the heart of all that is done. We build diverse, inclusive, and winning teams that drive our business.

Bold Innovations – Experimenting with fresh ideas and innovative thinking that shape our industry, through product development, process improvements, and customer experiences. Being obsessed with the consumer, we embrace change to drive growth.

Care & Challenge – Fostering an open, transparent environment where team members can grow, share feedback openly, holding themselves and each other to high standards while maintaining a strong sense of support and camaraderie.

Expertise in our category – A deep understanding of our industry, customers, and market trends enabling us to stay ahead and turn challenges into opportunities. Curiosity, insight, and a willingness to learn and lead enables us to remain market makers.

If these qualities resonate with you, we’d love to connect and explore how you can be part of our team.

Additional Information

As publicly announced, it is envisaged that Unilever will internally separate its Ice Cream business by July 2025, at which point this role will transfer to the new Ice Cream company. It is expected that the Ice Cream business will then separate from Unilever by the end of 2025. Any impact on terms and conditions of employment will be communicated in due course. This proposal is subject to consultation where legally required.

Job Description

Job Title: Zonal Expert Sales Manager

Work Location: Bangalore

BU: Unilever Health Science

Job Purpose

Health care professionals (Doctors)/Hospitals are the first point of care for patients in top-tier markets because of the need for quality healthcare and assured health services. To harness the opportunity that lies within hospitals, a dedicated Key account management team with customized Marketing interventions. The purpose of this role would therefore be to:

  • Leading a team of Expert Sales executives to deliver a plan for the region
  • Scan the HCP environment for new business opportunities for the hospital
  • Identify opportunities in different types of hospitals by evaluating risks, formulating action plans, implementing key strategies & monitoring effective deployment to enhance productivity in hospitals.
  • To support the Regional Expert Sales Manager in rolling out key marketing interventions targeted at HCPs and other key stakeholders in the Hospital environment
  • Establish the distribution structure in the covered geography in coordination with the Regional Expert Sales Manager aligned to the business needs of the segment.

Key Responsibilities

Implement strategy for new (and existing) market and business opportunities:

  • Drive marketing programs with clearly defined outcomes – i.e., new product introduction, increased penetration, and conversions
  • Establish and maintain contact with key opinion leaders / other stakeholders in Institutions through direct contact programs. Conduct external educational and awareness programs to build sustainable, long-term customer loyalty.
  • Generate, maintain, and utilize customer database for promotional use.
  • Coordinate with Hospitals and distributors to generate and execute the orders on time and for the settlement of claims.
  • Constantly identify new business opportunities in Hospitals and accounts with better realization and revenue scope

Monitor And Report

  • Monitor adherence to commercial/ compliance guidelines and reporting guidelines as prescribed by the company.
  • Analyse competitor activity and the industry environment to derive insights.
  • Analyse customer feedback on product quality and escalate concerns to the appropriate authorities

Liason

  • Liaise internally with cross cross-functional sales team and externally (with opinion makers) to obtain the required resources and ensure their utilization to achieve organizational goals.
  • Liaise with the purchase department, pharmacy, & administrators in Hospitals to obtain a favourable consideration for HUL products.

Breadth/Scope Of Accountability

  • Number of Direct Reports: around 10
  • Number of Indirect Reports: NA

Knowledge/Education Required

  • Minimum Level of Education Required: Bachelor's Degree
  • Area of Specialization: Science
  • Why is it required?

i. To constantly engage with Key Opinion Leaders like doctors and administrators

ii. To coordinate and conduct a clinical training program for healthcare professionals

iii. To consistently meet and achieve activation targets by effectively channelizing and utilizing available resources.

About Unilever

It is Unilever’s in-house centre of business partnering and operational excellence in the area of finance services, supply chain, customs, procurement, integrated planning and performance delivery. There are 300 people in Katowice Hub.

The modern Katowice Hub office, whose interiors were designed according to the principles of sustainable development, is located in the city centre of Katowice, Poland.

We are working in the hybrid way to use the time spent in the office to influence collaboration and straighten the team spirit, using special designed for this purpose office areas.

Job Purpose

Unilever is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. If you are an aspiring supply chain professional with a passion for numbers, processes and a drive to make an impact, then this role is just for you!

What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be

  • Be part of project teams that make an impact in 2Y Logistics across EU
  • Perform in-depth analysis to derive insights on operational optimizations, identify opportunities, and deliver recommendations
  • Drive workstreams with countries and/or partners to gather information and align insights of strategic & operational importance with stakeholders
  • Partner with internal and external teams to identify advanced analytical tools/mechanisms using internal data lakes and external sources (e.g., Reuters Tax Portal, Nielsen etc.)
  • Work on data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) to support data driven storytelling for senior stakeholders
  • Support in preparation of presentation decks for key stakeholder discussions
  • Work on continuous improvement initiatives on data analytics focussing on more readily accessible and easily replicable analysis usable for multiple countries

What You Need To Succeed

Experiences & Qualifications

  • Experience in advanced Excel, Power BI, Power query, PowerPoint
  • Prior experience in E2E Supply Chain (Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Strategic Planning)
  • Experience in data driven decision making and storytelling with data
  • Highly analytical mind-set with strong ability to identify, troubleshoot, problem solve and resolve issues while driving simplification and continuous improvement
  • Can work and build rapport with stakeholders across functions and seniority, in a multicultural environment
  • Strong ethical standards regarding the handling of confidential business information

Skills

  • Data Driven Decision Making
  • Problem Solving
  • Business Acumen
  • Storytelling and Influencing

Leadership

  • You are energized by delivering fantastic results. You are an example to others – both your results and your resilience. You are constantly on the lookout for better ways to do things, engaging and collaborating with others along the way.
  • As an individual you are the one responsible for your own wellbeing and delivering high standards of work. You must also focus on the Consumer and what they need. You are humble and have your head up, looking around to interpret evidence and data smartly, spot issues and opportunities to make things better.
  • Critical SOL (Standards of Leadership) Behaviors
    • PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE: Takes personal responsibility and accountability for execution and results. Has an owner’s mindset, using data and insight to make decisions.
    • PERSONAL MASTERY: Sets high standards for themselves. Actively builds own wellbeing and resilience.
    • CONSUMER LOVE: Whatever their role, always looks for better ways to serve consumers. Invests time inside and outside to understand the needs of consumers.
    • PURPOSE & SERVICE: Has humility, understanding that leadership is service to others, inside and outside Unilever.
    • AGILITY: Explores the world around them, continually learning and developing their skills.
Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life! This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid work and flexibility
  • Opportunities for the development and improvement of qualifications
  • Sharing the cost of professional training & courses
  • Benefits: life insurance, private medical care, pension fund, sharing the cost of sports activities, Benefits System – Cafeteria and many others
  • Extra days off to take care of yourself and others
  • Unilever store - Our products at attractive prices

ABOUT ICE CREAM: Life Tastes Better with Ice Cream

We turn the ordinary into the extraordinary by designing unique and innovative Ice Cream experiences that make life taste better, creating joyful experiences. In our Ice Cream business, we’re crafting the future through innovation and imaginative minds, creating unique products. We spark moments of happiness for people and within the communities where we operate. However, it is not as simple as it may seem. As Ice Cream makers we are serious about happiness. With warm hearts, we create the coolest products.

Job Purpose

You will be responsible for the support and delivery of ICE innovations to Market, partnering with other teams (Marketing, Quality & Assurance, Legal, Sales) and ensuring that R&D product information to consumer and customer is on time & in full.

The position is suitable for students with R&D/Food Science educational background and well as for candidates interested in flexible part – time (parents leave, etc)

Key Responsibilities

  • Complete local specifications for Ice Cream projects in Europe to enable digital data flow to customers ahead of product launch.
  • Input and review local technical data in the artworks process to ensure zero noncompliance or market incidents.
  • Assess any claims, business requests (e.g. saleable trials) and review any competitor challenges by using the available compliance network.
  • Answer product and pack-related inquiries from the careline and Sales. This refers to data available in the local specifications.
  • Adapt project Q&A and Selling stories for the local market, supporting Sales needs.
  • Identify improvements in the technical data management processes and support the digital transformation roadmap.
  • Serve as the first line of compliance contact in the country for compliance, managing local deviations / market practice specifics, and supporting technical product challenges.
  • Act as the ice cream R&D reference for local training to business partner, supporting tasting session, competitor monitoring and happy product process. Act as a local hear and eyes of R&D to innovation, product-packaging country trends.

What You Need To Succeed

  • Education in Food Science, Data Science, or related fields
  • Proficient in SAP PLM
  • Working knowledge of European & local foods regulations
  • Experienced in artwork process
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, calm under tight deadlines
  • Native Czech and advanced English are required

What We Offer

  • 30 days of vacation
  • Performance based annual bonus
  • Various benefit package (Multisport card, pension, life insurance, shares program, fruits & vegetable at the office and much more)
  • Laptop, mobile phone

Position Title: Senior Hospital Sales Executive

Grade:1B

Reporting: Zonal Hospital Sales Manager

Location: Mumbai

Job Purpose

Hospitals are the first point of care for patients in top tier markets because of the need for quality healthcare and assured health services.   • Scan the hospital environment for new business opportunities for hospital consumed HUL brands

Establish the distribution structure in the covered geography in coordination with Regional Hospital Sales Manager aligned to the business needs of the segment

  • Executive marketing programs with clearly defined outcomes – i.e. new products introduction, increased penetration, and conversions

  • Generate, maintain and utilize customer database for promotional use.
  • Coordinate with Hospitals and distributors to generate and execute the orders on time and for settlement of claims.
  • Constantly identify new business opportunities in Hospitals and accounts with better realization and revenue scope

Monitor And Report

  • Adhere to commercial/ compliance guidelines and reporting guidelines as prescribed by the company.
  • Track competitor activity and the industry environment for developing trends and practices
  • Track customer feedback on product quality and escalate concerns to appropriate authorities

Liaison

Knowledge/Education Required

Bachelors Or Master’s Degree in Science

Minimum Level Of Job-Related Experience Required

2-3 years experience

Internal: Zonal Hospital Sales Manager, Regional Hospital Sales Manager, BDE, KDE/ASE/ASM- Sales Team, Regional expert team.

job_description_formatted:
Job Title: Assistant Process Development Lead/Senior Process Development Specialist

Category: Packaged Foods (HUL Foods)

Location: Unilever R&D Bangalore

Main Job Purpose

The current role entitles work on process development for packaged foods category working with brands like Kissan, Knorr & Hellmann’s. The incumbent will be responsible for process development for a wide range of products like emulsified sauces (mayonnaise), non-emulsified sauces (ketchup, dipping & cooking sauces), cooking pastes (IMF & Retorted formats) and sweet spreads (jam/peanut butter).

Job Summary & Core Responsibility

Process Development

  • The incumbent will be responsible for driving Process Development working alongside formulation development team to deliver innovation, renovation or cost efficiency projects meeting the brief.
  • Innovate with new ingredients, flavors, and textures to meet evolving consumer demands.
  • Conduct experiments and pilot trials to validate process feasibility.
  • The Incumbent will be responsible for processing projects / work streams to create novel process-led product innovations which meet consumer needs.

Scale-Up & Commercialization

  • Translate lab-scale formulations into scalable manufacturing processes.
  • Collaborate with factory & supply chain teams to ensure smooth scale-up and consistent product quality.
  • Troubleshoot process issues during trials and production runs.
  • Ensure adoption of Core Process & Equipment Design principles as well as Hygienic Design Principles while landing innovations &/or new manufacturing site/line
  • He / She will be providing inputs for all technical upgrades on process improvements in supply chain with an aim to minimal/zero impact on existing product line.
  • To support site to site product transfers/stabilizations through providing key insight of product and its characteristics.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • The Incumbent will be responsible for partnering with cross-functional teams (Supply Chain/Procurement/Central Quality) to deliver relevant business critical activities involving processing support like development of new manufacturing site/lines, capacity enhancement projects, new raw material development, process optimization/standardization for product quality improvement
  • Align process development with brand positioning and consumer insights.

Regulatory & Quality Compliance

  • Ensure processes meet food safety standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Document process parameters, validations, and modifications for traceability.

Eco-system Collaboration

  • Engagement with external parties (Universities, research agencies and patterners, ingredient and technology partners) for efficient Process/Technology development for delivering business deliverables.

Consumer-Centric Development

  • Conduct sensory evaluations and incorporate feedback into process adjustments.
  • Monitor market trends and consumer preferences to guide process innovation.

Sustainability & Efficiency

  • Explore sustainable sourcing and environmentally friendly processing methods.
  • Optimize resource usage, reduce waste, and improve energy efficiency.

Key Interfaces: Supply Chain (Local & Global), Procurement, Quality, R&D team

Key Skillsets

  • Strong foundation in unit operations, food science/engineering, or process technology.
  • Experience with pilot plant operations, scale-up techniques, and manufacturing systems.
  • Knowledge of HACCP, GMP, and regulatory frameworks.
  • Analytical mindset with problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Expertise on Data visualization (e.g., dashboards for process KPIs), Simulation and modelling of food processes & Mathematical modelling for process optimization will be preferred

General Skills/Competencies

Excellent communication skills & influencing ability, both internal as well as external. Strong networking, organization, planning skills and information management. Demonstrated ability to manage senior stakeholder relationship Self-motivating with high problem-solving focus

Professional Background

B. Tech/M. Tech in Chemical Engineering, Food Technology/Engineering or related discipline. 5-8 years of work experience in reputed FMCG companies like Nestle, Tata Consumer Science, Heinz etc. Working knowledge/Expertise on emulsion-based products like mayonnaise, salad dressings is preferred Should be able to accommodate occasional 2 to 5 nights travel.

About Unilever

With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world.

At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future.

Job Purpose

Quality is a key driver of competitive advantage in the Personal Care business. The BU & Market Quality Operations (MQO) Quality Lead plays a crucial role in embedding a strong performance culture of quality within the business unit, ensuring every product delivers the best experience and delights our consumers. This role champions product safety and superior quality, leading teams with passion and precision to uphold the highest standards.

What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be

The Quality Lead will oversee aspects of product quality in PTAB with a turnover of over 2.5 billion Euros. The role will be responsible for deploying quality strategy, governance, and goals that directly impact marketplace success, our credibility with customers, consumer safety, and the on-shelf quality of our products. This, in turn, impacts Unilever's reputation and brand equity by ensuring quality that makes our brands unmissably superior.

The role will have oversight of all PC UL factories, quality manager in factory will report to role and also lead the MQO cross BU to support transformation, making our brands unmissably superior with safe products while collaborating internally and externally.

  • Governance to ensure compliance of products by design and delivery.
  • Partnering with the central expertise team on overall product safety, audit planning, and governance.
  • Responsible for partnering in PTAB business to develop a transformation strategy for BU on quality with consumer feedback and driving superior quality execution.
  • Leading MQO team cross Arabia and Türkiye, partner in local LT and drive quality culture to drive net productivity and consistent delivered quality.
  • Member of the PATB PC SCLT Team, leading quality strategic programs and quarterly governance with PCLT. Part of MQO
  • Define and deliver BU quality strategy and effective management systems.
  • Quality Council lead for PTAB, Lead cross BU quality team talent development and common agenda to drive culture across.
  • Conduct regular audits and inspections to monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of quality strategy delivery and next steps.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders to address quality issues and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Work with the innovations and operations team on consumer complaints, insights, and feedback for UBS intervention and progress.
  • Communicate quality objectives, performance metrics, and improvement initiatives to senior management and key stakeholders in BU and business partner PCLT.
  • Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes to ensure the company remains compliant and competitive in the market.
  • Support BU teams in developing and implementing the Quality Management System (QMS) to ensure fully compliant products - develop and maintain all relevant procedures in line with the requirements of global policies and procedures.
  • Ensure that the QMS is maintained in a state of inspection readiness.
  • Ensure systems are in place to manage local embellishment, re-pack, and co-packing work to meet all relevant standards and local requirements.
  • Maintain an effective Change Management system to ensure business changes are effectively managed.
  • Drive and deploy a digital Quality transformation program.
  • Lead the BU E2E Culture Quality Transformation Program.

Experiences & Qualifications

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED

  • More than 10 years of experience in SC and Quality.
  • A proven leader who is committed, enthusiastic, and capable of mentoring and upskilling the quality team. Able to inspire and motivate team with direct and dotted line reporting.
  • Has driven/been part of transformational cross functional project.
  • Strong knowledge of product safety, regulations and standards.
  • Quality management expertise: Developing and implementing quality control procedures, conducting audits, and managing quality assurance programs to maintain product safety and consistency.
  • Experience in virtual teamwork.
  • Experience in developing and maintaining a robust QMS, familiar with external accreditation audit processes.
  • Track record of delivering quality performance improvement within multiple large to small manufacturing sites.
  • Clear understanding and ability to assess and act upon product safety, quality, efficacy, and compliance risks.
  • Understanding of global and operational business strategy and challenges.
  • Proactive approach: Anticipating potential quality issues, implementing preventive measures, and continuously seeking opportunities for improvement.
  • Being flexible and responsive to changing regulations, market trends, and customer & consumer preferences to ensure quality processes remain effective and efficient.

Skills

  • Analytical skills: Utilizing data analysis tools to monitor quality metrics, identify trends, and implement corrective actions to improve overall product quality.
  • Communication skills: Collaborating with cross-functional teams, suppliers, and regulatory agencies to address quality issues, communicate quality objectives, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Problem-solving abilities: Resolving quality-related issues, investigating customer complaints, and implementing corrective and preventive actions to prevent quality deviations.
  • Auditing skills, appropriate qualifications as a lead auditor.
  • Excellent English &Turkish communication skills, both written and verbal .

Leadership

  • You are an inclusive motivator of people. Your team deliver with real passion, growing and learning from each other whilst delivering quick wins.
  • You are still responsible for your own results and as a manager, you also need to motivate others to deliver with passion, creating an inclusive and engaging climate around you. You can balance challenge with support and coaching. You understand the wider business context and you are emotionally intelligent enough to motivate people to deliver what is needed.
  • Critical SOL (Standards of Leadership) Behaviors
    • PERSONAL MASTERY: Sets high standards for themselves. Has emotional intelligence to take feedback, manage mood and motivations, and build empathy for others.
    • PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE: Generates intensity and focus to motivate people to deliver results at speed. Takes personal responsibility and accountability for execution and results.
    • TALENT CATALYST: Invests in people – coaches individuals and teams to realize their full potential. Creates an inclusive climate, empowering everyone to be at their best.
    • PURPOSE & SERVICE: Has humility, understanding that leadership is service to others, inside and outside Unilever.
    • CONSUMER LOVE: Invests time inside and outside to understand the needs of consumers.
    • BUSINESS ACUMEN: Creates sustainable growth with purpose, engaging different partners across the system for change.

JOB PROFILE

Company : Unilever Services (Lao) Sole Co. Ltd

Business Function : CBD

Job Title : Senior Distributor Executive (Province Based)

Overview

Unilever is one of the World's leading consumer goods companies, making and selling around 400 brands in more than 190 countries worldwide. With the key vision of making sustainable living commonplace, 2.5 billion people use our products to look good and get more out of life every day. We have been operating as Unilever (Cambodia) Limited since 2003 and have grown rapidly to become one of the leading companies in Cambodia. Our brands such as Viso Pises, Breeze, Comfort, Sunlight, Lux, Ponds, Vaseline, Citra, Sunsilk, Clear, Dove, Close up, Knorr, Best Food, Lipton, and Wall’s are widely available throughout the Kingdom and are the market leader in the category.

Main Duties And Responsibilities

The Distributor Assistant Manager will be responsible for leading and managing a sales team within a designated territory of distributors. The primary objective of this role is to drive sales growth, ensure great product distribution, visibility, optimize effective coverage with great territory management and increase market share.

The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, exceptional sales/ business acumen, and a deep understanding of working capital, ROI and operation in the FMCG industry.

Sales Strategy And Execution

  • Implement effective sales strategies to drive business growth by translating monthly CD priorities & company strategy into great execution.
  • Set sales targets and objectives for the assigned distributors and monitor the performance of the sales team to ensure targets are achieved.
  • Provide clear guidance and support to front liners (distributor sales team) and identifying sales opportunities, negotiating deals, and closing sales.
  • Conduct regular market visits to monitor in-store product availability, visibility, promotional & monthly campaign activities.
  • Monitoring sales activation and support all MDM program to build brand penetration and increase market share.
  • Analyze market data and sales reports to identify trends, gaps, and spot on opportunities through channel, category lens to maximize sales.

Team Management And Development

  • Work with distributor team to recruit, train, and motivate a high-performing sales team.
  • Set clear performance expectations and conduct regular performance evaluations.
  • Provide coaching, guidance, and feedback to maximize individual and team performance.
  • Foster a positive and collaborative team environment.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and business partners.
  • Monitor customer satisfaction levels and promptly address any concerns or issues.
  • Stay updated on market trends, customer preferences, and competitor activities to identify new business opportunities.

Territory And Outlet Management

  • Develop and implement effective outlets coverage (direct & controlled stores), giving clear direction and monitoring to ensure right PJP/ frequency setting in assigned distributors.
  • Build strong fundamentals of sales through FCS (Field Capability Score) KPIs improvement.

Sales Reporting And ROI/ Working Capital Analysis

  • Prepare accurate sales forecasts, promotion plan and reports.
  • Analyze sales data, market trends, and competitor performance to identify areas for improvement and develop appropriate action plans.
  • Join monthly business review with distributor to identify gap and opportunity, ensure all monthly KPIs are delivered as plan.
  • Support RSMs on distributor ROI data and working capital analysis, to ensure stability of good cash flow management, and healthy profitability.

Skills And Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
  • 5+ years of experience in sales or related roles, preferably in the FMCG industry.
  • Strong fundamental of sales operation and great discipline in execution leading.
  • Proven track record of achieving sales targets and driving business growth.
  • Excellent team management and leadership abilities.
  • Strong customer relationship management skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret sales data and market trends.
  • Effective communication and negotiation skills.
  • High commitment, great discipline, resilience, result-oriented and able to work under pressure.
  • Familiarity with sales reporting and analysis.
  • Adaptability and willingness to travel within the assigned area.

How To Apply

The Interested candidates are invited to apply online and submit your updated resume to Unilever Careers Site.

Your application will be reviewed against our requirements and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

If you have any questions about your application, please kindly contact our HR team via Recruitment.Laos@unilever.com

Application will close by 21st Match 2025

We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! Thus if you require any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of your application so that we can support you through your recruitment journey.

We are looking for a CBD Excellence Executive to work with our CBD Excellence team in the Customer Development department.

The CBD Excellence team is involved in the management and development of the Cost Operations and Operational processes of DT operations in our ice cream business. The teammate sought in this field is expected to have the competence to manage operational processes with analytical thinking.

Main Responsibilities

  • Making systematic definitions of the costs within the scope of Cost+ system for all Ice Cream DT operations, and also monitoring and reporting them.
  • Making SAP definitions, budget tracking and reporting for all Ice Cream DT operations. (Investment Fund, Under-Invoice discount, DT premiums, etc.)
  • Opening POs and tracking invoices through the Coupa system in operational costs.
  • Creating reports by analyzing the annual cost increases of the DT Cost budget on the basis of Operation and Region.
  • Collecting all cost items managed by the CBD Excellence team and creating the closing files for the month and year.
  • Analyze the root causes of cost increases and uncover saving opportunities by collaborating with local and global teams.
  • Ensuring that the operations are working within the plan by actively following the annual cost plans.
  • Providing the necessary digitalization by developing Cost Reporting models and Peracost system and to simplify all cost processes.

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in university
  • To be able to use MS Office, SAP and Coupa systems at a good level and to be open to development in these matters.
  • Willingness to work closely with multinational teams as well as senior management,
  • Proven skills and abilities in analytical thinking and complex problem solving,
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Enthusiasm for making the ice cream business the leading supplier in a digital, knowledge-based world,
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Fluency In Written & Spoken English & Turkish

Work together with Local Stakeholder and functions (Adpro Team, Marketing, Finance, F4G CMI) execute the sourcing strategies, operating models, and supplier relationships that help drive 4G growth in accordance with our plans, including a focus on Accountable Sourcing strategies. Lead rigorous execution of the priorities and transformation initiatives across the Markets E2E, look for development opportunities. Synergies between global design and local execution, consolidation, and transformational commercials. Ensure Portfolio fundamentals (i.e., data consistency, data insights, recurring stakeholder communications, contracts, quality processes etc.) are all put in place for Markets in scope. Future proof the portfolio for the Markets by driving digital approaches, while building technology enablers to help manage selected portfolio and scope, via an impactful sustainability agenda. Support internal performance management and reporting including creation and stewardship of relevant key performance indicators. Business partner by internal stakeholders, and as a sharp, challenging steward of Unilever resources by external vendors. It will be critical for the successful candidate to understand and unlock the power of digital technology to identify, eliminate, and where possible, automate non-value added processes in both within Unilever procurement, and across the business more broadly. Therefore, an understanding of systems and processes and strong analytical acumen to drive insights and action from data around how we operate is essential. You’re a strategy guru. With great analytical skills, you are able to do gap analysis and act on the insights found. Working with marketing services, you will be able to find a link between intangible assets and their outcome and determine success, always having a look at the end to end impact. You’re a storyteller. You are aware of your audience and able to show passion to inform, influence and persuade. Motivate and make others want to take action. You’re a culture and change champion. You are able to navigate into an ever-evolving environment requiring agile adaptation and reaction. You’re a dot connector. Working with marketing services procurement, you will be the connector between internal and external stakeholders, making sure that needs are translated and understood correctly and delivered in the best way possible. job_summary: ABOUT UNILEVER With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world. At Unilever, your career will be a unique journey, grounded in our inclusive, collaborative, and flexible working environment. We don’t believe in the ‘one size fits all’ approach and instead we will equip you with the tools you need to shape your own future. JOB PURPOSE Unilever is the place where you can bring your purpose to life with the work that you do – creating a better business and a better world. The technician is a Preventative Maintenance and Focused Improvement specialist engaged to optimize the running and maintenance of equipment within the factory. Where breakdowns occur, the multi-skilled technician will act to diagnose and troubleshoot faults and where necessary will recommend design improvements. She/he is also intimately involved with setting the Maintenance Strategy for the respective production area. The Technician is professionally competent and qualified to operate safely at a post apprentice level in at least two of the principal engineering disciplines; electrical & Instrumentation and Control. She/he must be a mentally agile and advanced problem solver actively engaged in maintaining a safe work environment, which protects product quality and reduces waste and other environmental impact. A positive contributor to the factory’s work environment and culture, the technician will act as a leading coach and mentor to the Technical Operator around the areas of engineering and Unilever Manufacturing System techniques. WHAT WILL YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES BE Guarantee the expected machines and equipment reliability on production areas to meet the requested production capacity and accordingly with the budget. Define and plan all necessary maintenance activities according with the budget. Organize, update, and archive the documentation regarding maintenance of machines and equipment. Analysis of breakdown reasons and preventive actions consisting in modifying the maintenance plan to avoid the failure recurrence. Support maintenance teams during problem solving concerning machines and equipment reliability. Definition and implementation of SMP. Definition and supervision of spare parts and their availability in the warehouse. Collaborate to define the specific indirect materials supply for maintenance department machines and equipment. Continuous collaboration with Operative Maintenance on production area and with Product Engineering. Make sure that equipment and machines maintenance plan includes activities to meet the expected safety and quality level. Develop and implement new technical solutions and managerial methods to improve machines and equipment reliability and maintainability to improve equipment performance and reduce maintenance cost. Support Product Engineering during test on production areas. During the acquisition of new equipment, participate to reliability analyses (EFMEA) at design phase and try out. Participation in acceptance of machines and equipment (new and after modernization) Cooperate to define and plan the proper training for maintenance technicians. Contribution into continuous improvement activities regarding process and services. In the range of the executive autonomy take the needed decisions and make the proper actions to improve tasks regarding environment. Guarantee the confidentiality of the documentation. Make sure that maintenance third party companies operate accordingly with company’s policy WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED Experiences & Qualifications Mechanical Engineering degree. 0-2 years of experience Consumer & Customer Focus. Building world class factories will eliminate losses and ensure that we do not pass on the cost of inefficiencies to our customers and consumers. Bias for Action. By providing consistent and near real time information, decisions can be taken quickly which leverage our resources. Building Talent & Teams. Our vision is to move to semi-autonomous teams, and we require Maintenance Reliability Engineer’s with a passion for achieving results through great teamwork, an ability to teach new tools and methodologies and ensuring that you and your colleagues are fully aligned and drawing on one another’s strengths. Accountability & Responsibility. Taking responsibility for building your team’s performance and sharing your best interventions to help support other lines in their improvements. Growth Mindset. By building world class factories, we will become more competitive in the marketplace and set the standards to which others aspire. UMS. Apply the full set of UMS methods and tools to identify root causes, define countermeasures and validate their effectiveness; Establish standards to support line operators and mechanics sustain new basic conditions. Process and Organizational Design. Leverage technical knowledge and a systems approach to ensure factory lines and processes are optimally resourced (e.g. manpower ratios are efficient and sustainable). Analytical capability. Collect and analyze complex data to penetrate problems’ phenomena and understand root causes. Skills Able to visualize clearly what the ideal production system is. Able to clearly understand operating principles and establish correct operating standards. Able to present findings and rationales clearly so that whole factory team can understand. Able to make logical decisions based on data. Possess challenging and pioneering spirit. Digital skills – Powerbi and Microsoft Office Fresh Mechanical or Electrical Engineering Graduate Leadership You are energized by delivering fantastic results. You are an example to others – both your results and your resilience. You are constantly on the lookout for better ways to do things, engaging and collaborating with others along the way. As an individual you are the one responsible for your own wellbeing and delivering high standards of work. You must also focus on the Consumer and what they need. You are humble and have your head up, looking around to interpret evidence and data smartly, spot issues and opportunities to make things better. Critical SOL (Standards of Leadership) Behaviors PASSION FOR HIGH PERFORMANCE: Takes personal responsibility and accountability for execution and results. Has an owner’s mindset, using data and insight to make decisions. PERSONAL MASTERY: Sets high standards for themselves. Actively builds own wellbeing and resilience. CONSUMER LOVE: Whatever their role, always looks for better ways to serve consumers. Invests time inside and outside to understand the needs of consumers. PURPOSE & SERVICE: Has humility, understanding that leadership is service to others, inside and outside Unilever. AGILITY: Explores the world around them, continually learning and developing their skills. Unilever embraces diversity and encourages applicants from all walks of life! This means giving full and fair consideration to all applicants and continuing development of all employees regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage and civil partnership, and pregnancy and maternity. Unilever is an organisation committed to equity, inclusion and diversity to drive our business results and create a better future, every day, for our diverse employees, global consumers, partners, and communities. We believe a diverse workforce allows us to match our growth ambitions and drive inclusion across the business. At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! Thus if you require any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of your application so that we can support you through your recruitment journey. Show more Show less

Location: Unilever R&D Bangalore

Background

Unilever’s Science and Technology (S&T) team in the Personal Care Business Group creates future technologies to deliver unique consumer products with a wide range of superior, differentiated benefits. Within S&T, the Physical Sciences Platform translates relevant science generated both internally and externally into a stream of innovative consumer products. The Physical Sciences team includes deep expertise in chemistry, emulsions, material science, surface & colloid science, and process engineering. Their common purpose is to create a steam of benefit-led products by unraveling the understanding of ingredient interactions and product interaction with biological substrates. The research deliverables from the team support the innovation pipeline over the next 5 years. They primarily take the form of next generation products scaled at least to pilot plant level, but may also include novel claims, claim support measurements, and expertise & authority. In addition, the team often partners directly with Design teams to solve critical product-based problems or to provide deeper insight into new technologies, products, or processes.

This role will be part of the Physical Sciences team located in Bangalore, India.

Main Job Purpose

The individual in this role will join an integrated, cross-laboratory team dedicated to developing innovative products, with a primary focus on delivering benefits through personal care formats like soap bars, liquid cleansers, and deodorants. They will be tasked with studying the impact of novel actives towards betterment of skin health and skin feel. This work will involve close collaboration with R&D partners in related disciplines, external experts, and business partners to ensure the research outputs have maximum impact and are effectively delivered.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Design and S&T project leaders, as well as science area leaders, to investigate both current and emerging technologies for the development of innovative products. This requires a comprehensive understanding of the various functional materials employed in the formulation of personal care products.
  • Gain a comprehensive understanding of the skin benefits derived from formulation ingredients, and investigate new active components that can enhance skin health and feel.
  • Develop a range of analytical characterization techniques to provide insights into the interactions of active compounds on the skin. This role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Identify and manage projects/interactions with external partners, especially serving to build a 3P/cross laboratory network of relevant product characterization capabilities critical to the Product Engineering skill bases.
  • Design and conduct experiments at laboratory scale to identify product design rules relevant to specific projects.
  • Manage the transition of technology from the Science and Technology platform to the Design teams.
  • Proficient in data analysis and documentation, with knowledge of digital tools and modeling (optional).
  • Possesses outstanding communication and collaborative abilities.

Key Requirements

  • BE, BTech (2 to 8 years' experience) or MS, MTech (1 to 6 years' experience) in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, Materials Science or related discipline with a strong understanding of the physical science bases underpinning personal care products.
  • Open to MS, Mtech freshers in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biochemistry, Materials Science or related discipline.
  • A strong foundation in interfacial and colloidal sciences is essential.
  • Experience in working with personal care formats, their characterization, and relevant characterization techniques.
  • Proven track record of creative scientific problem-solving skills.
  • Working knowledge of surfactant/colloid science and physical chemistry to enable linking measurements to product design rules would be a plus.
  • The ability to work effectively across multiple teams, geographies and functions.

Job Summary

Finance Supervisor – Inventory is a crucial role responsible for managing and maintaining a company's inventory, ensuring accurate stock levels, timely reporting, and compliance with company policies. This role involves tracking and analyzing inventory movements to ensure the accuracy of inventory balance in line with accounting requirements. Apart from that, this role also helps optimize inventory accuracy, minimizing discrepancies, and supporting operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accountable for day-to-day inventory movement to ensure inventory accuracy and inventory compliance
  • Manage and monitor month-end closing activities. This includes reviewing the monthly Inventory provisions to ensure alignment with the policy and analyze changes.
  • Maintain and analyze inventory information to provide insight of inventory (i.e. Inventory reconciliation, Trend analysis, Trial Balance Review)
  • Perform manual stock in transit (SIT) booking and ensure accuracy of SIT transactions and analyze changes.
  • Review, create, develop, and implement internal controls regarding inventory management to enhance stock accuracy and comply with Global Policy
  • Coordinate with the operation team for the Cycle count process and perform analysis before adjusting in the system.
  • Lead as a finance representative and collaborate with other functions and external parties for stock count and stock destruction activities.
  • Support internal, external and tax audits related to inventory part as required
  • Provide inventory-related information upon request (i.e. stock loss report to tax team)

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in related field (e.g. Business/Finance/Economics/ Accounting/etc.).
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Finance (e.g. FMCG/ Finance Partnering/ Industrial/ Auditing/ etc.)
  • Strong analytical, mathematical, data analytic, spreadsheet modeling skills.
  • Responsible, Accountable, Cautious in ensuring financial accuracy.
  • A good team player with agility, positivity, and a willingness to go the extra mile.
  • Possess good communication and presentation skills in both Thai and English.
  • Required to commute to warehouse or factory from time to time if needed

Job Title: Ice Cream Production Front Line Manager

Location: Waterbury, VT

Terms & Conditions: Full time

International Assignment - International assignment is not available for this role and relocation for local and international candidates is not provided

The Ice Cream division at Unilever is preparing to stand on its own, aiming to become an independent, EUR 8.3 billion publicly listed company by the end of 2025. We’re on a mission to create the ultimate snacking company. A place where growth, innovation, founder and ownership mentality, and performance are cultivated and rewarded. And where we craft extraordinary ice cream experiences - transforming ordinary moments into lasting memories. Because we know, life tastes better with ice cream.

About The Magnum Ice Cream Company

The Magnum Ice Cream Company is all about growth. Growing our business. Growing our customers’ businesses. Growing our people’s careers. Growth begins with empowerment. So we free our people to be innovative, responsible entrepreneurs, driven and equipped to give our consumers more amazing products and unforgettable moments – and having fun doing it.

With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.

We have been taking pleasure seriously for more than 100 years, serving happiness with every lick or scoop of ice cream for generations.

We are investing to unlock the full growth potential of The Magnum Ice Cream Company as a standalone entity, once we separate from Unilever, which is planned to happen before the end of 2025.

We dream big but keep things simple to act fast.

If you want to grow with us, make an impact, and shape the future of Ice Cream, this is the place for you!

BEN & JERRY'S

Ben & Jerry's Homemade Inc., started in 1978 in a renovated gas station in Burlington, Vermont, USA, founded by childhood friends and dedicated activists Ben Cohen and Jerry Greenfield. In 2000 Ben & Jerry’s became a wholly owned subsidiary of Unilever whilst maintaining an independent Board of Directors to provide leadership focused on preserving and expanding Ben & Jerry's social mission, brand integrity, and product quality. Unilever is now demerging its Ice Cream Division and establishing The Magnum Ice Cream Company, the largest global standalone Ice Cream company! Nowadays our products are distributed in 35 countries in supermarkets, grocery stores, convenience stores, franchise Ben & Jerry’s Scoop Shops, restaurants and other venues.

At Ben & Jerry’s We Have An Inspiring Ambition. We Aim To Pioneer Our ‘linked Prosperity Business Model’ To Advance The Global Movement For Social And Economic Justice While Growing To Be a Billion Euro Brand. Therefore, We Are Expanding Rapidly In Europe As Well As In New Markets In Asia And Latin America. This Translates Into a High-paced Growth Environment Where We Bring Our Grassroots And Activist Spirit Every Day. That Is How We Remain a True Values-led Organization With a Connected 3-part Mission, Which You Will Find Reflected In Your Goals And Aspirations

Social mission: to initiate innovative ways to improve the quality of life locally, nationally and internationally

Product mission: to make and distribute the finest quality all natural and super premium ice-cream and euphoric concoctions

Economic mission: to operate the Company on a sustainable financial basis of profitable growth

It takes a variety of people and disciplines to navigate this odyssey. Interested in joining our mission to fill store shelves with our ice cream? Our Vermont Manufacturing team is currently looking for an Operations Front Line Manager to support Manufacturing Activities for our site in Waterbury, VT.

Job Purpose

Our Front-Line Manager is personally responsible for overseeing production & warehousing related activities performed by approximately 25 employees on shift as well as leading Continuous Improvement related activities. This individual should have a strong background in continuous improvement methodology, such as Lean, Six Sigma, TPM, etc, in order to: drive process improvement and team development through the implementation of The Magnum Ice Cream Company techniques; establish a world class manufacturing environment in which employees have a framework of operating systems based on the methodology that guide their way of working; coordinate and/or conduct training based on the processes; and foster a cultural change towards self-directed teams.

Key focus areas for continuous improvement will be in the realm of safety for our people and for our product, waste reduction, improved efficiency, zero defects, zero environmental loss, and customer satisfaction. In addition, as an employee, you are encouraged, to participate in company volunteer projects, community service initiatives, and social mission teams.

What Will Your Main Responsibilities Be

  • Driving current and future manufacturing performance in the areas of Safety, Quality, Productivity, Cost, Delivery and Morale
  • Oversee activities of the site; Communicate, investigate and address problems and situations, actively engaging in improving the site’s performance.
  • Facilitate the development of the shift employees through training, coaching, feedback, and performance management
  • Supervise the manufacture of quality products to meet product specifications in accordance with GMP, SPC, and manufacturing specifications.
  • Recommend and review staffing needs to achieve production schedules
  • Ensure a safe work environment exists by implementing and maintaining work safety standards, training and bringing action plans to closure.
  • Prepare, maintain and analyze manufacturing reports related to quality, efficiency, waste & attainment through Loss Tree approach
  • Consistently administer company policy and practices
  • Continually improve the quality of each area through process innovation and methods improvement
  • Plan and execute plant trials for new product innovations
  • Membership and active participation on the Hazmat team is a requirement of this role
  • Other projects and duties as assigned

What You Will Need To Succeed

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business, Operations Management, or other applicable field required or additional experience in lieu of degree
  • Must have a minimum of 2 years of supervisory/lead experience in manufacturing environment; food manufacturing preferred
  • Demonstrated knowledge, skills and abilities through experience in production, materials management is required
  • Must have experience in UMS, Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, or other continuous improvement program
  • Effectively lead, coach, and motivate team members towards an autonomous team environment
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to handle interpersonal issues effectively and influence others through a matrixed environment is required
  • Must have the ability to manage projects and project teams from inception to completion including hitting deadlines and communicating progress
  • Working knowledge of Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and ability to drive improvements using the Loss Tree is required
  • SAP and warehouse management skills / experience preferred

What We Can Offer You

Meet the Women of Customer Development | Culture for Growth | Top Notch Employee Health & Well Being Benefits | Every Voice Matters | Global Reach | Life at Unilever | Careers with Purpose | World Class Career Development Programs | Check Out Our Space | Focus On Sustainability

We dream big but keep things simple to act fast. If you want to grow with us, make an impact, and shape the future of Ice Cream , this is the place for you! The role sits within the Scientific Affairs team, more specifically the Global Research, Development & Innovation (RD&I) Microbiology Team, and will be based in Sarigazi, Turkey. The Ice Cream business in METSA Region is large and highly successful. The Ice Cream Regional Design Center (RDC) located in Sarigazi/Istanbul is the driving force behind the creation and delivery of benefit-led, innovative ice cream products across our world-renowned global (e.g. Magnum, Cornetto, Twister), premium local (e.g. Carte D’or, Maras) and regional (e.g. Vienetta) brands. The team embrace agile innovation and are fully connected to country teams to land innovation and renovation projects in the markets. The team is closely connected to local marketing and customer development teams and support their relationships with regulatory authorities, customers (e.g. by developing compelling selling stories that drive sales of our products) and consumers. The business reaches across all ice cream experiences under two broad platforms: In Home and OOH (in-home tubs, log and pints and out of home experiences such as scooping non portioned and mono portions) and Impulse which includes global and local stick, cup, cone formats under Kids, Snacking, Cone and premium ranges. Our Team Ensuring that The Magnum Ice Cream Company (TMICC) products are safe to consume is of paramount importance for the business. The Global Scientific Affairs function, which is part of RD&I, brings together Food Safety, Regulatory Affairs and Nutrition expertise to ensure that TMICC products are safe-by-design and compliant with relevant regulations & nutrition requirements. As well as protecting the business, the Scientific Affairs function is also key to unlocking innovations to enable business growth. One of such functions is the Global RD&I Microbiology team. Global RD&I Microbiology is an agile team of enthusiastic world-class scientists who deliver business relevant microbiological solutions underpinning brand innovation programmes, based on scientific and technological capabilities across RD&I and Supply Chain (SC). The strength of the team lies in the integration of microbiological and processing knowledge for RD&I to develop safe/stable formulation & process designs to deliver winning products. The Ice Cream Microbiologist will work within the Global RD&I Microbiology team delivering up-front microbiological solutions and security across our RD&I innovation portfolio and business operations, supporting iconic brands such as Magnum, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s. This is a critical business need as robust data-driven microbiological support: (1) provides the unlock to maximise value from data (faster and sustainable innovation, incident prevention and mitigation, cost efficiencies), (2) provides a solid basis to perform microbiological risk assessments and (3) enables the business to deliver better for you and planet products. This role will be based in Sarigazi (Turkey), co-located with the Ice Cream Regional Design Center, and reporting into the Global RD&I Microbiology team based in Colworth, UK. Job Purpose Working as an integral member of our enthusiastic team of microbiologists, you will play a key role in supporting new products and processes development projects in RD&I and providing microbiological support to our global business operations. Main Responsibilities Include Ensure microbiological safety of our Ready-To-Eat ingredients by working closely with our Global and Regional Microbiologists, Suppliers, RD&I project leaders, Quality, Procurement, and Ingredient Specialists to align on procedures, review decontamination processes and validation reports, and provide expert guidance for decontamination and validation procedures, as well as delivering decisions on RTE ingredient approval/rejection. Supporting the METSA Business Unit where RD&I Microbiological expertise is needed and drive compliance with Global Microbiology requirements by working closely with the other colleagues from the Global RD&I Microbiology team for alignment and sharing best practices. Conducting microbiological risk assessment for RD&I support (e.g. product development, RTE discussion) and Supply Chain support (e.g. for incident and process control). Assure microbiological safe and stable products and processes by actively implementing a Safe-By-Design approach. Partner with Global team to identify and adapt new methodologies/process/procedures enabling continuous future fit microbiological data science. Deliver technical input for relevant documents and training materials to ensure renew/maintenance of product & process design knowledge. Designing and supervising laboratory project work which will be done either in-house or in cooperation with third party labs. What You Need To Succeed Background (minimum BSc) in Microbiology, Applied Biology, Food Safety, or a closely related science area. Preference for previous experience in Microbiology linked to Food Industry, and understanding of food decontamination processes (thermal and non-thermal). Molecular Biology (DNA sequencing interpretation) is an advantage. Basic working knowledge and experience of using Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook). Excellent communication skills, written and oral to present in multidisciplinary teams and to various stakeholders, both in English and Turkish. Ability to manage complex stakeholder discussions. Ability to learn and work in fast paced environment with varying priorities and demands, demonstrating problem-solving skills where necessary. Team player with flexible “we can” attitude, yet, ability to work independently and defend own science-based knowledge in front of stakeholders. What You Can Expect A unique mix of global scale & start-up spirit—€8.3bn powerhouse with an agile, entrepreneurial mindset. We’re building a new high growth Ice Cream company from the ground up. Career without limits—42 markets, international opportunities, and fast tracked growth. A performance-driven culture—Freedom to act, disrupt and grow – your success is measured by impact. A company that celebrates joy, innovation, and purpose—We create extraordinary careers, just like our ice cream creates extraordinary moments. Additional Information As publicly announced, Unilever will separate its Ice Cream business which is expected by the end of 2025. This role will transfer to the new Ice Cream company.
